Ez a preflight-részlet önmagában nem teljes coding-agent prompt. A prompt writer továbbra is egyetlen angol, copy-ready, bizonyítékokra épülő teljes handoffot ad.

## 19. Completion report és befejezési feltételek

Az alap-szabályzat teljes completion reportján túl külön eredménytábla kell a scope-ba tartozó négy hibaterületre. Mindegyik sor jelölje:

- baseline és final alkalmazási SHA/build;
- vizsgálati és fizikai státusz;
- mintaszám, mérési kezdő-/végpontok és időalap;
- mért eredmény és regressziós összehasonlítás;
- tényleges output/evidence és annak korlátai;
- fennmaradó hiba vagy nem vizsgált felület.

A report tartalmazza az R… kockázati sorok tényleges ellenőrzését, a fixture előfeltételeit, a gyors/célzott/teljes futások külön eredményét, a teljes CI belépési tábláját és minden hibacsoport naplóhivatkozását. A diagnosztikai útvonal tervét, implementálását és sikeres kipróbálását külön státuszként jelölje.

A report külön tartalmazza a reviewer átadott diagnózisát és tervét, valamint az agent által ténylegesen mért új tényeket, eltéréseket és artifactokat. A következő oksági következtetést a reviewer végzi. EVIDENCE_COLLECTION lezárásakor a kijelölt evidence átadása történt meg; ebből nem következik javított alkalmazás vagy lezárt fizikai hiba.

Külön kell közölni a javítás implementálását, automatizált igazolását, az artifact elkészültét és a fizikai elfogadást. A „kész”, „smooth” vagy „latency fixed” nem lehet egyetlen teszt zöld státuszának átnevezése.

Az implementációs szállítás akkor tekinthető ellenőrzötten átadottnak, ha az érintett contractok tesztjei, a védett regressziós ellenőrzések és a releváns delivery-feltételek teljesültek; a kimaradt vagy sikertelen ellenőrzések pontosan meg vannak nevezve; a napló és a teljes report elérhető.

A fizikai hibát csak a felhasználó exact APK-ra adott visszajelzése zárhatja le. Addig a végső fizikai státusz szó szerint:

`PHYSICAL VALIDATION — PENDING, USER ONLY`

Új elfogadott lockscreen- vagy launcher-widget mérföldkő csak explicit fizikai elfogadás után rögzíthető, pontosan megnevezett viselkedésre és ismert korlátokra. Egy animáció elfogadása nem foglalja magában automatikusan a megjelenési és eltűnési késés elfogadását.

### Architecture card

R = `android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/fluvi/app/lockscreen/material/KeyguardOrbBufferRenderer.kt`.
T = `android/app/src/androidTest/kotlin/com/fluvi/app/lockscreen/material/KeyguardHeaderMaterialViewInstrumentationTest.kt`.
Only R, T and this journal change in the application candidate; tooling is a
separate commit. The existing renderer is the sole buffer lifecycle mechanism.
Main remains the only writer of visibility, parenting and child removal.
Worker remains the only slot/use/state owner, with the existing fence Handler
providing completion to that owner. Atomic exact-object grants communicate
Main's authority; revocation captures the retiring lease AND child. The new
Worker operation only submits a null buffer to that captured child after any
already accepted steady submission. Successful clear does not free ownership.
No controller/service/shader/Flutter/workflow/fixture-budget changes are allowed.

Observations are immutable, constructor-captured and passive. Production logs
are bounded lifecycle/exception samples on Worker; test-only accepted/submitted
samples carry exact lease/child/slot/use identity. Existing callbacks and real
fences remain the only ownership write path. No second pool, loop, executor,
watchdog or recovery policy is introduced. R and T already exceed 800 lines:
they remain cohesive renderer ownership and its platform-instrumentation suite;
this scope explicitly excludes a cross-file extraction or unrelated refactor.

### Hypotheses and reviewer decision

**H1 selected — first/on-draw publication escapes the retirement ordering fixed by R06.** PROVEN source mechanism: `Api34.publishReady` hands the first setBuffer+show transaction to `root.rootSurfaceControl.applyTransactionOnDraw`, then marks it published and enables steady direct submissions without observing its actual commit. Main withdrawal and the R06 Worker final null-buffer clear use direct apply. The Worker queue orders steady work against final clear but does not order the previously deferred ViewRoot transaction against either. This creates a source-permitted stale first submission / retained first-use boundary. The exact physical or historical runtime interleaving remains UNPROVEN.

Corroborating CI evidence: repetition2 PID3690,821288ms, final clear for lease32/87 child106089338 returns. At822790ms all three slots are PUBLISHED, path first/on-draw, receipt=false: retired10/27 slot1/use87; retired32/87 slot2/use207; current33/89 slot3/use185. It identifies first uses but cannot establish which branch each one took. One goal of the forced test is to resolve that limitation.

**H2 retained — accessibility acquisition and event/Main scheduling account for measurable portions of W-SHOW/W-HIDE.** Acquisition and queue delays above are PROVEN; their underlying cause and any shared-thread/GPU contention are UNPROVEN. No cache-flags flip, positive classification shortcut, speculative early show or unsafe early hide is authorized by this handoff. Preserve complete negative-marker/privacy checks. 8. CURRENT SOURCE FACTS

R.Worker at R07 lines 1288–1350 caps the pool at three across current and retired uses. Without a FREE slot it increments dropped and returns. observeStarvation at 1641 logs only. Old-size outstanding slots can also cause ensureResources to return before the index lookup. R.hideLayer/revokePublication and R.consumeRelease/finishFence already separate losing display authority from reclaiming a buffer. A receipt with a valid fence still needs the signalled fence. Keep the first/steady release paths and old-child cleanup intact.

C.reconcileClock at 641 pauses the orb View and stops its Main clock whenever the isolated route is selected and healthy. Lack of capacity does not raise an exception. C.onIsolatedOrbFailure at 1074 already contains a real View-renderer recovery path for a producer exception. It retires isolated publication, makes the retained View visible, prepares the legacy path on demand and reconciles the clock. C.update, onAttached and prepareDetachedIsolatedOrbBackend selection paths must agree on effective ownership. In particular update can set isolatedOrbRequested=true for an eligible configuration and setBootstrapActive(true) even if the old failure flag stays set. A superficial call to onIsolatedOrbFailure leaves reconfiguration/reattachment cases unresolved. V.resume uses the View's previously paused time and V.setScene returns early on equal visual keys. Neither alone transfers the running isolated phase.

S sends a post-withdrawal attachment render summary and an instrumentation diagnostics map. F.actualOutputCount currently picks isolatedPublished whenever its lifetime value is positive. Once an earlier isolated frame exists, this masks every subsequent View frame. Its inverse would allow a stale View to make a failed isolated route green. Both comparisons need an explicit owner.

14. IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT

A. Classify actual render capacity at its owner. Implement the admission predicate in R.Worker using its existing slot records. Evaluate at accepted positive setAttachment and in existing active frame opportunities, before ensureResources can return on a dimension conflict. No new timer. No collection allocation per frame in production. Detached prewarm, no live publication grant, wrong/obsolete desired/attached lease, or inactive child are ineligible. Distinguish unavailable old uses, READY/in-flight current work, available capacity, and successful submission. Names below express required semantics.

    exact = running && !disposed && attachedLease == spec.lease &&
            spec.lease.attachment > 0 && currentGrant.active &&
            currentGrant.lease == spec.lease
    retiredUse = slot.retired && slot.lease != spec.lease && slot.state != FREE
    completeOldBlock = slots.size == 3 &&
            all three are retired PUBLISHED uses without a recorded release
    noSuccessor = no FREE slot && at least two retired uses in
            PUBLISHED or WAIT_RELEASE_FENCE && no current RENDERING or READY_FOR_MAIN
    incompatible = existing size guard rejects the requested dimensions
            because of at least one still-owned retired wrong-size use
            and there is no current submitted/ready/in-flight compatible work

    if exact && completeOldBlock: offer one ticket now
    else if exact && (noSuccessor || incompatible):
        after >= 3 distinct eligible frame opportunities and >= 50 ms monotonic uptime
        continuously in the same condition without a current output advance, offer one ticket
    else: reset this pressure interval; invalidate an unclaimed ticket

The 50 ms plus distinct-opportunity condition is a proposed R08 transient filter for this declared state; it never releases a buffer or creates a visibility decision. Reset the series on lease/grant/condition change, restored compatible capacity, permitted progress, retire or dispose. Publication of one current frame starts a new interval; an ongoing healthy pipeline does not qualify. If only two old buffers are held and the third is FREE, let the new lease use it normally. 8. CURRENT SOURCE FACTS

R.Api34.hideLayer (~842) revokes the grant and clears/hides the captured child on Main. R.Worker.revokePublication (~1249) posts a second null-buffer clear after accepted steady work on the Worker handler. Only onLeaseDrained (~906) removes the child from the retiring map, reparents it to null and releases the local handle. Worker real-release bookkeeping and fence completion separately authorize slot reuse. The most recent commit listener available in the phone hide row is for the Main hide transaction. It cannot establish completion of the later Worker transaction.

R.Worker.ensureResources (~1617) returns false on any wrong-sized non-FREE slot before inspecting reusable capacity. Render then selects the first FREE slot without explicit dimensions. The pressure policy sees wrongSizeOld before considering productive spare slots. R.Api34.ensureLayer (~751) builds a new position transaction whenever an existing child is reconciled, even on the same coordinates. It then calls worker.setAttachment; keep its notification semantics.

C.update (~381, 430–446) retires the full child, updates the scene, calls orb.setScene, then conditionally restores orb visibility using activeOrbLease. V.setScene can synchronously promote a prepared program and notify the controller. Reconciliation can therefore see partially updated replacement state. The archived white sample alone cannot prove this was its cause. W.showOrUpdate records ADD_VIEW_RETURN before materialController.onAttached and the first-root observer; POST_ADD_SETUP_COMPLETE already exists. W.hide first sets root invisible and calls removeViewImmediate after stopping child ownership. S already listens to user-present and screen-off, and inspection participates in visibility authority. Preserve the authorized withdrawal decision and observe time before and after it.

10. ROOT-CAUSE OR FORENSIC GATE

H1, selected product repair: a retired child may retain its last compositor association while the app waits on precisely the releases needed to tear it down. Break the child-lifetime dependency safely. Prediction: after the last clear commits the old child is unparented even when the app has deliberately withheld delivery of an already received release. The slot remains owned until that release and its fence pass. In unforced service cycles, measure whether real releases, replenishment and isolated successor publication recover. If exact unlinks complete but old releases/NO_SUCCESSOR persist, H1 has achieved teardown only and is unsupported as the capacity/performance fix. Do not hide that with a fallback PASS.

H2, confirmed conditional algorithmic defect: a single wrong-size busy slot can block usable independent slots. Support requires a current-size, visually correct successor while an old wrong-size use genuinely remains held. H3, cold/show: remove redundant same-position applies and measure where the first root and first live opportunity actually go. A falling transaction count without lower latency supports only the deduplication result. H4, privacy: fix the verified ordering hazard and run a positive neutral-pixel control on both routes. A repeatable white crop after corrected geometry fails this contract. For W-HIDE, isolate delivery delay from the few milliseconds between decision and local hide. Attribute any improvement only to the segment that changed. Nothing in this plan predicts when Android must deliver an accessibility event.

12. LAYERS / BOUNDS / OWNERSHIP

Main owns the current authorized scene, WindowManager, child parenting/visibility and geometry, attachment and publication grant. Worker owns exact slot/use, GPU producer state and ordered final clear. The compositor owns a published buffer until the actual release callback and any valid release fence complete. A transaction commit is permission to advance the specified child-lifecycle step only. The existing dedicated fence lane remains responsible for waits. Never block Main, Worker rendering, immediate local withdrawal or a new show waiting for a commit or a fence. Old grants, full images, test hooks and completion callbacks cannot affect a new lease. Retire old slots safely even after detach/dispose. Pool cap is three total, across all leases and sizes. Use existing renderer-level recovery latch and its healthy restoration rule. Keep one animation owner per visible scene, no background work when hidden.

Platform reference for the API 35 semantics: https://developer.android.com/reference/android/view/SurfaceControl.Transaction and https://developer.android.com/reference/android/view/SurfaceControl . Separate transaction commitment, layer unparenting, local handle release and buffer release in code, tests and report.

14. IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT

A. Replace the retiringLayers value in Api34 with a small Main-owned retirement record keyed by immutable lease and verified by exact child/reference and record identity. Publish it before revoking. Immediately revoke publication authority, locally hide and clear the exact A child on Main as today. Split synchronous authority revocation from posting ordered final-clear work if needed, so the Main initial hide/clear apply attempt has finished before the final Worker clear is enqueued. Preserve the volatile exact-grant revocation before hide. The Worker handler must order its final clear after every already-accepted steady submission for A. Current-B lookups are illegal for this operation. Main proceeds to WindowManager removal without waiting.

Register an actual transaction-committed listener on the Worker's LAST null-buffer clear of A. Register before apply; a listener-registration error must not suppress the clear. Send lightweight typed completion events back to Main for final apply return/failure and exact commit receipt. Preserve an independent real-drain notification. Join the callbacks by record identity in either delivery order. Core rule:
    eligibleToUnlink = mainHideAttemptFinished && workerFinalClearAttemptFinished &&
        ((workerFinalClearApplySucceeded && exactFinalClearCommitReceived) || actualLeaseDrained)
After this rule, Main submits a separate reparent(A,null) in a closed transaction and releases the child handle once after successful unlink submission. Never use the earlier hide commit or a first-frame commit here. On unlink failure retain the exact unresolved record, expose failure, permit the existing actual-drain event a single safe cleanup opportunity if still pending; no unbounded retry. If registering the final listener fails or there is no receipt, use the old genuine-drain route after Worker has finished touching A. Once unlinked, late callback processing identifies uses by immutable token/id only. Do not dereference a released SurfaceControl in a late listener. Keep teardown routing for pending retirements alive after renderer disposal while genuine callbacks/fences drain. Never erase legitimate slot ownership, synthesize release, or allocate a substitute for a held slot. Preserve and test the separate path for unpublished render results. Use close/finally on transaction and resources on all exits.

B. In Worker.ensureResources replace the whole-pool size veto with bounded per-slot preparation. Reuse a matching FREE slot if possible. Close/remove only FREE wrong-size slots and refill remaining capacity at current size as needed. Check supported dimensions/usage. Keep distinct identities for replacement storage. If creating the renderer or node fails after buffer allocation, close only resources just constructed; do not affect outstanding slots or leak partial allocations. Preserve the same failure route. In render select FREE with exact current width and height. Keep the existing READY/RENDERING handoff limit. In evaluatePressure and the block-reason export, describe effective capacity coherently: wrong-sized old ownership can block when no safe, productive current-size successor can be built, not whenever any old size exists. Account for unallocated capacity below three. Preserve ALL_OLD_UNRELEASED and NO_SUCCESSOR, per-grant observation, real-success cancellation and the original thresholds. One current published frame without capacity for successors cannot qualify as sustained health. No new shader allocation on steady frames.

C. In Api34.ensureLayer cache the actual child, active attachment/root parent generation, lease and last successfully submitted x/y. Child creation/reparent/initial placement, any real parent/geometry change and any failed submission invalidate the appropriate cached state. On repeated unchanged placement skip only the redundant position transaction. Keep every existing worker.setAttachment notification in its original ordering and leave real configure/layout/root-preDraw readiness checks intact. Close temporary transactions. Count successful submissions and suppressed duplicates with bounded cheap instrumentation.

D. In C.update on full→discreet, establish a Main-owned restrictive transition generation before calls that can synchronously notify or reconcile. Revoke old full publication/tickets, retire its child immediately, clear previous-full blend/static fallback, publish only the current permitted scene. Apply V's existing neutralized profile/bootstrap and make the already-authorized attached orb View visible and invalidated as part of this same update. Do not predicate neutral View restoration on activeOrbLease being null: a reentrant new lease is not a committed neutral frame. Defer reentrant reconcile requests only until this coherent update completes, then reconcile once. Respect hidden roots, animation OFF and unsupported modes. Use the existing neutral gradient/scene and normal orb clipping; retain transparency outside the orb and existing Portal behavior. Never reintroduce old pixels on a stale ready, pressure ticket, restored-capacity or commit. A current exact committed replacement may retire the neutral bootstrap. A pressure View stays visible and uses its own permitted animated scene. Do not hold old full pixels while waiting for a new buffer. Keep disposal and synchronous exceptions safe. Gate shipping on T-privacy; correctness of this code path alone does not prove the cause of the archived screenshot.

E. Instruments belong in this same APK. At W.showOrUpdate retain existing ADD_VIEW_RETURN/POST_ADD_SETUP_COMPLETE plus actual View attach, valid target geometry, preDraw/root draw when observed, first worker request/start/result, READY post/Main entry/first apply/commit for this exact show. Use existing observers and fixed per-attachment timestamp fields; where attach already happened at instrumentation, mark it as already attached rather than inventing an event time. Track exact retire reason/child/lease/slot/use and separate final clear submitted/committed, unlink apply, actual release and fence, current successor, route restoration and first two advancing frames. At hide retain source accessibility event time when supplied, callback, inspection enqueue/start/finish, Main apply/decision, local hide, optional exact-child submit/receipt and remove return. For alternate real user-present/screen-off/exclusion signals record earliest eligible received signal, source and reason within the same wake/visibility epoch. Prevent terminal cleanup of a detached overlay from replacing actual withdrawal in the summary. Do not force an earlier visibility decision.

For cross-callback chronology use uptimeMillis, for the paired app/Choreographer draw stages use their existing monotonic nanosecond domains, and retain thread CPU for owned work. No wall-clock subtraction across domains. Preserve the worst detailed draw gap across attachments first, then one worst for remaining attachments within the existing byte budget, then lower-priority samples. Never count unsampled physical endpoints as zero. Use compact fields on the diagnostic worker, no per-frame stringification, screenshots or synchronous I/O on Main. Preserve critical IDs, counters, UTF-8 cap 32768 bytes, capture-off fast path and original FULL/LIGHT behavior.

15. PERFORMANCE GATE

W-SHOW: report first authorized attach separately from later attachments. Measure screen/cycle→decision→add begin/return→post-add setup→first root→current live, and the Worker first-work/ready→Main path. Compare equivalent source, capture mode, palette, scene size, service cold/warm state and route. Record unobserved vs delayed endpoints. Do not reward moving a marker earlier unless the correct current output also advances. Quantify cold queue/root service calls separately; no shortcut around lockscreen authority.

W-LOCK-ANIM: split isolated and pressure View. For healthy isolated require distinct successive authorized frames and actual image change. For pressure require moving output with held old uses plus safe restoration when real capacity returns. Record visibility opportunity, largest gap and its component times, 95th percentile only with disclosed sample count, frame phases, ownership, and dropped/missing evidence. Do not combine isolated publication counts with View traversals into FPS. W-HIDE: report first actual attached withdrawal per comparable reason, original event→callback, callback→decision, decision→local, optional child commit, remove return; correlate earlier independently observed exclusion only within that episode. Separate actual compositor samples, app timestamps and user report. W-HOME-ANIM: protected out-of-scope surface; disclose automated coverage and physical status.

Use candidate and original runs under identical configuration for available panel metrics. A single cold observation establishes a severe outlier, not its frequency. Report sample counts and every outlier. If receipt-driven recovery improves yet show/hide or draw gaps remain poor, give three separate verdicts. Include diagnostic-producer max/total normalized by opportunities/duration, losses and capture-lock owner. FULL versus LIGHT is a conditional control for observer cost, not the next mandatory user test.

12. LAYERS / BOUNDS / OWNERSHIP

Main owns authorization, current scene, root, child and privacy. Worker owns prepared resources, desired render demand and all slot-use transitions. An object stored in latestOrbScene only establishes (i) or desired content, not (iii). A detached frame always has zero presentation authority. Renderer/fence completion may still arrive after supersession. Its callback must reclaim only its own use. No UI call waits for a prime to finish. A skipped duplicate must not mark an unprepared program as ready or cancel a positive authorized job.

T10-A, true first-show path. Start a fresh renderer/controller/window with a visible-test harness capable of creating a real authorized panel. Explicitly prepare the production ORB and wait for the real successful detached producer result and safe retirement of that use. Hold the first physical target attachment using a controllable fixture seam, never stall the Android Main looper with sleep. Call the normal W.showOrUpdate(loading, same settings). Include synchronous cache-hit/promotion/size callbacks. Count submissions by renderer/lease, dimensions, configuration key, pass count and request reason from prepare until two verified positive frames. On R09's unmodified logic or an explicitly labelled observation-only baseline demonstrate duplicate detached demand or preparation-only previous scene where reachable. On R10 require exactly one qualifying initial warmup, zero detached submissions attributable to authorized show, no previous scene or second shader pass for first positive output, genuine first/direct plus a distinct advancing successor with the correct image. A test that begins only after valid panel geometry and withholds the NEXT draw does not test first-attach latency.

T10-B, arbitration. Inject one controlled delay at a time: detached request queued but unsubmitted; genuinely issued detached render/fence still outstanding; prime already successful; no prime supplied. Positive configure/grant and async artifact completion may arrive in either order. Assert obsolete unsubmitted work never renders, submitted work drains against its original lease, B never borrows A's pixels and can use legitimately available capacity. With two old published uses and one real pending detached use, no fabricated fourth slot or fake release. Freeze the old render result, then release it and require B advances or follows the genuine existing pressure contract. Also reproduce the R09 forced retirement fixture without starting a new detached prime from hide/show reentrancy; preserve exact release checks. Run rapid detach/dispose/replacement, program, dimension and privacy mismatch, differing renderer instance and real failure/recovery. Cleanup releases every test barrier in finally.

T10-C, genuine visual changes. First show after prepare and warm reattach select current-only. A visible steady same-key refresh changing an unrelated presentation field keeps phase and issues one pass. A genuinely different permitted palette A→B on the same visible authorized root retains the established 180 ms transition and distinct A/B images. Check same-effect clock continuity. Full→discreet immediately invalidates old pixels/tokens and never creates a previous-full pass. A stale READY/commit cannot conceal current permitted content. Preserve actual pressure View animation, older API/static behavior and withheld-next-traversal first/direct.

T10-D, actual timing. Assert the observation distinguishes registered-pending from actual attach, has independent identities on reattach, and keeps post-add, preDraw and draw samples on their original clocks. Test a no-draw withdrawal and callbacks crossing a visibility epoch. Test positive/zero lease overlap with release completing late; every result is reported under the submitting owner. A missing endpoint exports UNOBSERVED. Test capture-off and single-observation behavior, including cancelled/late sentinel callbacks.

T10-E, export. Synthetic production-shaped 4 retained attempts with verbose inspections, multiple hides and R09 retire rows, 2199-event pressure, 9 real gap details containing 3 distinct maxima. Add cold-path probes and test FULL and LIGHT each against the 32768-byte UTF-8 limit. Require compact actual withdrawal and cleanup identifiers for each retained operation, full cold first-path causal fields, and the actual global-worst available detailed gap with owner, duration and callback/draw timings. Lower priority omissions must remain explicit. Check a larger-than-reservation field and multi-byte strings. Do not cap the measured duration or write a synthetic gap.

Pixel controls and red evidence: repair the demonstrably wrong phase-A positive reference in T.isolatedOrbFirstDirectAppearsWhileNextRootDrawIsWithheld. Bind expected material time/phase, target geometry and request to an independently calibrated producer readback and compositor reference; validate discriminating B and bootstrap controls. Retain 12 target samples, prior-withheld-next-root semantics, compare the actual circle mask and preserve whole images; never replace a failing target with its own expected image. Calibrate neutral/empty reference windows with geometrically fixed crops on actual presentation backgrounds, an external fiducial or equivalent marker outside the target, explicit frame/commit identity and independently verified pixel contrast. A CPU bootstrap counter or waitForIdleSync alone is insufficient. Record bounded original target strip from tightening (including first sample), timestamps/geometry, and a synchronized subsequent strip. A true white/empty eligible target or old full image fails even if five later frames pass. Record any sample before the intended compositor boundary separately and keep it for review. No masking entry frames or waiting for a matching target screenshot and calling it first. If corrected fixtures still show a product privacy failure, retain review-only status and deliver the independent cold evidence. The reviewer has not authorized an unrelated privacy architecture change.

14. IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT

A. Separate explicit detached preparation from the pre-add update. In W.showOrUpdate, once the real surface decision selected a fresh attach, enter a narrowly scoped pending-authorized-show state BEFORE apply(current, …) and updateMaterialForPresentation. Carry it through C.onAttached on success. End/cancel it on add failure, replacement, hide or dispose in a guaranteed cleanup path. This state grants no child or visibility rights. C.update should still accept the latest permitted profile, install/bootstrap the View as appropriate and resolve artifacts. During the pending-show interval its reentrant reconcile paths may update desired state but may not configure a lease-0 producer. Only the explicitly requested C.prepareDetachedIsolatedOrbBackend for an actually detached eligible renderer can ask for an offscreen prime. Hide, V.setScene, restore of View visibility, onSizeChanged or a late artifact callback alone cannot start a detached prime. Distinguish a valid armed async prime from an obsolete callback. Use the existing chronological positive attach/configure/parent/grant path when W succeeds. On add failure release pending authorization, keep safe prepared resources; later valid show or explicit preparation still works. No preattached surface, root attach before authorization or positive publication on an unattached root.

B. In R's Worker keep a bounded single-flight preparation record per current resource lifetime. Use the existing immutable effective program/artifact, ORB shape/render variant, target width/height/format, effective visual/privacy and renderer resource generation as necessary for correct reuse. A new lease number, capture ID, timestamp or same-palette reconfiguration alone does not invalidate a genuinely compatible prime. Keep “queued”, “actually submitted”, “prepared successfully”, “failed/invalidated” distinguishable. Repeated requests for the same queued/in-flight/ready resources do not call requestFrame again for detached work. A changed compatible uniform/phase should not become a reason for per-wake preparation. Reset readiness on actual replacement/disposal/resource loss or incompatible target; keep storage bounded, without retaining previous bitmaps. Production correctness must be identical with capture disabled.

Recheck current demand at Worker configure, opportunity entry and immediately before submitting a detached draw. An authorized positive request supersedes a still-unsubmitted detached demand. Existing unreturnable GPU work stays in the original slot until its actual render fence permits safe reuse. Keep scheduling the real positive demand through existing legal grants/availability. A pending old frame callback must re-read the desired lease; cancelling an obsolete detached callback may not swallow the first positive frame. Avoid idle callbacks when neither detached nor positive work exists. Preserve positive handoff and original pressure cadence; do not invent opportunities to satisfy pressure thresholds. Count priming preparation separately from an actual positive publication. Do not hold READY lease 0 as a display cache or rerender all three slots to make a test pass.

C. In C.update and its render spec, separate phase anchoring from selecting a previous layer. Preserve the current phase/paused-time rules. A previous scene/artifact and 180 ms transition start are permitted only for a genuinely different effective visual on the same still-authorized visible attachment with previously submitted eligible content and matching disclosure. Exclude initial show, detached/prepared-only state, withdrawal/reattach, equal effective visual, mode change without continuous ownership, and restrictive change. Use existing first-publication/visible-View signals or a small Main-owned previous-content record tied to actual attachment and scene. Set it on exact positive submit or verified current View draw, clear on withdrawal/new attachment/ownership or privacy invalidation; reject stale callbacks. Do not use “prepared”, wall-clock age or a non-null latestOrbScene as evidence of prior display. Preserve a legitimate in-progress A→B blend through duplicate updates. Keep latestOrbPreviousScene/latestOrbPreviousArtifact null and transitionStartedNanos=0 for current-only. In R.prepareSlotShaders/render verify current-only produces exactly one drawScene with full blend weight, binds only the current shader, and preserves the profile's own opacity, orbital geometry, phase and content. Do not modify the shared shader algorithm. The first positive frame must be rendered for its own lease.

D. Instrument only the decision-making boundaries. Arm one cold observation on the real root before add, retain actual attach dispatch, first layout/size, postAdd, preDraw and onDraw. Capture when attach already happened without forging a timestamp. From the same bounded cold operation optionally post one asynchronous Main queue availability marker (API35 Handler.createAsync), plus one Worker handler marker. Normal synchronous Main messages can wait behind Android's traversal synchronization barrier even when the Main looper is available. Treat both markers as liveness observations, never as timing shortcuts. No blocking, post-at-front, forcing traversal, reflective framework calls or startup timers. On Worker record exact lease/slot/use, request purpose (explicit preparation/current live), key/pass/previous-valid bit, configure receipt, actual frame registration or already-pending state, doFrame entry/frame time, first consequential return reason, ensureResources and prepareSlotShaders bounds, before/after GPU submission, result/fence, ready→Main→apply→commit. Capture at most the first two detached and first two positive submissions plus bounded failure summaries per cold episode. Preserve whether a slot was already primed and which request was superseded. Distinguish app Worker's submission, RenderThread graphics work, frame callback and real screen composition. Archive low-cost matching async Trace sections with deterministic short IDs in the diagnostic run. Record monotonic/uptime/elapsed trace alignment; never subtract phone vs emulator clocks. Avoid strings/maps/listeners per ordinary frame, process names or financial content in phone logs.

E. Modify D.formatReport admission order. Calculate UTF-8 bytes for the actual mandatory compact records, limits for variable fields and honest omission metadata before selecting verbose inspection/episode blocks. Reserve the first attempt's cold path, actual attached withdrawals and terminal cleanup IDs/states, tight show/route identity for first plus last three, and one worst measured detailed gap with its owner even if the verbose episode cannot fit. Then add remaining details round-robin, stripping duplicate historical R09 first-work copies from unrelated attempts or explicitly tagging origin. Protect current legacy fields/console consumers; add versioned compact fields and explicit optional detail flags, and update consumers/tests if a moved row would otherwise be lost. Maintain recovery/header byte accounting. For the R09 physical shape an empty DRAW_GAPS section plus two missing cleanup IDs fails this contract. Timing capture never controls product behavior.

15. PERFORMANCE GATE

Measure the first authorized attach of a new service process separately from later attachments. Primary endpoints are screen-on or independently labelled cycle start to first CORRECT compositor sample on the real overlay and to first correct advancing successor. Also report actual app timings from add return to preDraw/root, to first current submit and commit. Report bounds between last negative and first positive screen samples when precision is limited. No display sampling in normal phone production. For R09 vs R10 on the same API35 environment capture cold first-show red/green data using identical palette, renderer, UI state, device profile, resolution, refresh and profiling/capture setup. Use two independent fresh-process cold episodes per source, fixed in advance, including one later warm wake per episode for context. Same emulator snapshot/emulator build policies and app-data/driver cache state for both, or record the difference. No selective discarding of stalls. Do not label a process restart a cold driver cache.

App invariants: one legitimate genuine detached warmup for stable compatible inputs, zero redundant detached submissions due to authorized show, zero fake initial previous passes, two fresh successive correct current frames when sufficient capacity is available. Preserve geometry, privacy and genuine animation. Report each sample, delta and route. To classify cold performance as improved on the tested runner, both paired first-correct-image comparisons must favor candidate beyond their sampling uncertainty and neither may merely trade an earlier bootstrap for a later current frame/second frame. Mixed or overlapping results are INCONCLUSIVE. No claim of physical success from emulator results. If a long stall remains, disclose its actual stage and thread evidence. Keep W-HIDE matched by actual hide cause, W-LOCK-ANIM by route/opportunity and W-HOME-ANIM protected and distinctly identified. Retain per-mode diagnostic costs and omissions.

Freeze identities and archive original CI. Add read-only red counters/behavioral test seams and the fixed cold-run harness. Run original-source cold control. Implement A/B, then C with its phase/pixel controls, then D/E and focused fixture corrections. Compile early. The one-purpose real-service cold experiment is independent of the unrelated focused privacy assertion and must produce a trace/evidence even if the full panel is red. Use only the isolated test device for this diagnostic. The ordinary release workflow still requires all existing gates. Implementing fewer diagnostics must never make an otherwise drawing or held-out case pass.

Missing Api34.attachment alone must never label a positive use as detached.

B. One existing first READY use can be offered. Use one atomic state transition per ownership handoff with exact token, lease, slot/use, acquire fence and production offer timestamp. State model: open/empty → pending(A) → claimed(A) → settled, or open/pending→revoked. If revoke wins before offer, producer drops its unpublished A once. If offer wins then revoke wins before claim, revocation takes A for discard. A posted stale notification contains only its token or scheduling identity; it cannot close a captured fence independently. While a test continuation is deferred after claim, retain its revocable once-only disposition until it either truly submits or discards. Use a normal coalesced notification with a lost-wakeup-safe recheck or remove the exact stale callback on revoke; keep pending messages/frames bounded. Check post failure as an actual failed handoff/disposition. No new Main/Worker joins, fence waits on Main, busy loop, frame copies or additional pool occupancy. Do not store a SurfaceControl/View on a background thread as new UI authority.

C. Two callers, one Main-only consume function. (1) After Worker offers A it schedules the ordinary Main wake. (2) At the tail of a successful ensureLayer, after worker.setAttachment installs the live exact target and before returning from this callback, attempt the same consume. No READY → return; no legal child yet and token still current → keep pending; revoked token → settle using its exact invalidation path. When both are available, claim once and validate active root, layer, child, route, lease and dimensions again at actual dispatch. Invoke the existing firstPublicationHook through both paths, including held/delayed continuations, and preserve the exact first/direct transaction in publishReady. On genuine hide/reconfigure purge any never-published pending or hook-held use exactly once even if another layout never occurs. Do not fire the hook again via a second grant/nudge. An already-published use must never reach dropReady; its mismatch fallback can close the handed fence. An ambiguous apply retains conservative ownership until real feedback. Successful direct send still orders worker.markFirstPublished before a later retire; bootstrap retires only on the exact first commit. The steady Worker path and receipt/retirement barrier keep their behavior.

D. A grant may be issued during controller/renderer re-entry on a synchronous artifact cache hit. Install all existing controller token/scene/attach state first. Do not consume using the prior configuration on same-root size/privacy changes. The call must honor restrictive transitions, View fallback and true hide. Read-only observation cannot issue a grant. Repeated unchanged placement must not trigger a second position transaction or second direct apply. Proof of success is actual transfer of the same A under both event orders and correct pixels, not a call to a standalone mock state machine.

E. Add bounded operation-correlated Debug Console evidence in the same APK. Capture original capture/session/showOp, attach/generation, renderer, slot/use, grant/child identity, READY, atomic offer, regular nudge entry, grant installed, claim origin, actual apply begin/end, receipt, worker ack, first distinct steady submit, and exact disposition/reason for drop/revoke/ambiguous apply. Define bothReady = max(offerAt,actualValidGrantAt) only for the same non-revoked identity. Export bothReady→apply and direct→successor, distinguish missing and losing callbacks; preserve semantics of R10's original timestamps. Use monotonic uptime for joined endpoints, System.nanoTime and Debug.threadCpuTimeNanos for short shader scopes. On only the first two current uses record the actual per-slot program-key hit before construction, whether constructor ran, and wall/CPU around prepareSlotShaders. Do not change prewarm policy.
     Use existing bounded capture-owner and snapshot flow in renderer/controller/service, plus KeyguardCardSettings.formatReport compact admission. Add matched event/callback/local-hide/remove and route to compact actual withdrawal when known, especially when verbose rows are omitted. Make correct original pending/settled evidence available on freeze while visible without needing a hide, IO on Main, blocking a Worker, or attaching later results to a newer capture. Prefer compact codes/omitting duplicate verbose text over exceeding the UTF-8 limit. Preserve worst gap and original omission accounting. No per-frame console formatting or logs. Measured pixels belong in external test/phone evidence only.

8. CURRENT SOURCE FACTS

FluviKeyguardCardService processes Binder tree reads off Main and applies visibility on Main. In processInspectionQueue (~982), non-stale inspection waits in withContext(Dispatchers.Main.immediate) for applyInspection (~1494) before complete(active) can release a pending request. handleRecoverableSurface (~1702) reads pendingRequest, chooses a freshness obligation, preserves pending work while detached, or withdraws/reacquires after visible UNKNOWN. It must still observe the correct pending identity. The current policy performs a fresh system admission read at actual show/disclosure increase. Authority covers session, wake, visibility, interaction and attach generations. Existing terminal signals can withdraw without a successful tree walk.
The window owns addView, geometry, clicks, callbacks and removeView. prepareRetainedView may run before eligibility. settings.showFinancialDetails expresses preference, not permission for the next visible frame. Full/discreet is determined by current authorized presentation. Existing material controller chooses the isolated backend on its supported API/mode/animation path and can fall over to a Main-driven View. KeyguardOrbBufferRenderer retains custom slots, direct first apply and separate steady publication/retirement. On later R11 episodes the pressure route has no first-offer work. The old driver and the pressure clock must never be present in the default new path. KeyguardHeaderMaterialView contains the actual canonical scene/time/shader contract. Sharing immutable material descriptions is permitted; mutable shaders, Paint, Canvases or View instances must respect their thread owners.

9. PROVEN / UNPROVEN / MISSING

PROVEN: first-direct event ordering improved on R11's first retained episode; physical feedback rejected R11. Admission spent 135–251 ms after SCREEN_ON before SHOW on warm retained episodes. Later cycles ran the pressure View. Long intervals between CPU traversals and slow external event delivery exist. One direct send, a commit callback or publishing many buffers has not established smooth visible pixels. Previous controlled runs also demonstrate buffer-retention and independent-image-oracle problems in the legacy route.
UNPROVEN: how much the legacy multi-owner pipeline, Main traversal, shared HWUI/RenderThread/GPU scheduling, system wake/unlock transitions, diagnostics or service event delivery cause the perceived lag. In particular the three warm gaps cluster near withdrawal. The 182 ms callback-delivery delay does not prove a 182 ms covering bootstrap. OS events can arrive after the visual transition. No claim of a universal lag-free renderer or an Android timing guarantee.
MISSING: system wake/unlock visual start, physical first correct ORB, physical first sustained motion and last visible ORB on A142. Exact vsync/latch/present for these logs, early trustworthy emulator pixels, and a comparable baseline for stable locked intervals are missing. Normal final gates on R11 are missing. Obtain discriminating evidence with the repair in R12; do not request another unchanged R11 run.

10. ROOT-CAUSE OR FORENSIC GATE

Selected structural hypothesis H1: first/steady publication can depend on different owners and retained slots; the surviving fallback moves animation back to Main traversal. Removing app-owned buffer/fence bookkeeping and Main traversal from ongoing ORB motion, while keeping the first correct image ready and giving presentation one owner, will reduce post-admission delay or long visible gaps. Alternative H2: much of wake-to-visible is spent before authorization; a compatible next tree read can start sooner without changing when an answer is allowed to show anything. First R11 inspection finished at 1133947812, Main entered at 7899, next read started 7902. H2 addresses that exposed ordering dependency only, not system Binder latency. H3: visible unlock delay includes receipt of the first usable system signal and compositor removal. Immediate local revocation is in scope; changing platform admission criteria or guessing future unlock is outside scope. H4: OS scheduling, HWUI/driver/compositor or capture overhead can dominate across producers.
Precommitted interpretation: LEGACY versus SURFACE_LIVE under the same admission engine tests H1. SURFACE_STATIC versus SURFACE_LIVE isolates the incremental animation path with identical window, gate and first pixels. Stock R11 plus on/off read-ahead in an instrumented identical dispatcher tests H2. Separate locked steady motion and unlock-aligned samples discriminates H3/H4. A punctual producer with stale composed frames moves the investigation downstream; late authorization with short SHOW→correct pixels moves it upstream. If both new modes still show the same visible delay at the same boundary as legacy, report H1 insufficient and return the matching traces. A shorter software marker alone cannot select a winner.

11. SCOPE LOCK / NO-TOUCH

Migrate the existing isolated-eligible standalone lockscreen ORB/orbOnly animated case (including API 35 and existing eligible API 34+ devices), with the existing permitted full and discreet variants. Other SDKs, animation-off configurations, CARD/background, launcher RemoteViews and Flutter dashboard retain their supported rendering and behavior. Retain known legitimate exclusions, ownership, window type, bounds, click/drag behaviors, focusability, settings, palette and offline data. No persistent overlay under keyguard, new system privilege, notification-timeout trick, frame-skipping policy that hides stalls, forced release, global process/thread-priority override, large exported data, or off-screen live animation. No global switch to SurfaceView on unrelated routes, and no deletion of the legacy controls before separately authorized physical acceptance. No new financial settings screen.

12. LAYERS / BOUNDS / OWNERSHIP

Service/Main alone authorizes disclosure and synchronously revokes presentation. One existing bounded accessibility overlay root owns logical visibility, layout, touches and removal. Add exactly one SurfaceView child on the candidate route, default Z below its parent UI but above the window background via the normal SurfaceView hole, with per-pixel translucent holder configured before creation. Use the real ORB resource-derived bounds and centered circle; never setZOrderOnTop or create a second WindowManager window. Test alpha over two known contrasting underlays and verify touch remains with the original root. The old material View with XML ID fluvi_financial_snapshot_orb retains its original typed behavior for CARD/legacy; use GONE/lazy creation per route. Avoid a hidden competing animation, old pool, driver or cold GPU preparer for candidate. Root preparation when detached must create no live Surface, scheduled frame loop or visible window.
One HandlerThread/Looper per active ORB rendering service owner while required; worker owns shader instances, mutable drawing state, phase and its Choreographer. Main owns view/holder callbacks and forwards an immutable target with generation. Keys bind service, capture (for evidence only), wake, show/attach, surface generation, privacy epoch, palette/material digest and actual pixels. One pending frame callback, one newest immutable scene update, one current target, one in-flight holder operation; delayed messages carry their original identity. No app-owned HardwareBuffer slot pool, cross-thread apply, first-vs-steady buffer handoff, SurfaceControl child or pressure switch for the candidate. SurfaceView still uses platform queues, HWUI, RenderThread and GPU; worker-thread API calls do not establish independence from platform scheduling.

13. REQUIRED RED TESTS

Add behavioral tests first. For portions impossible on stock R11, run the unchanged control using test-only observation/injection and show its historical/observable limitation. For newly introduced behavior use an explicit negative control such as a delayed worker, disabled read-ahead or stale generation and prove the oracle catches it. A missing method or failing compile is never a RED. Keep original tests, skipped counts and artifacts.

T1 Admission: hold Main application of a completed detached NO_MAIN_MARKER A with compatible queued B. Old queue cannot begin B until release. Candidate begins exactly one B read under the same authority while A's decision is pending and remains invisible. Test both synchronous/queued apply, B finishing before A, new latest C, retry budget, hidden→visible/withdrawal, stale A/B, ROOT_UNAVAILABLE, truncation, force-clear, screen off/user present and disposal. No public SHOW from B before ordered fresh Main validation; no deleted request or concurrent Binder walks.
T2 First image: real service window + real current Surface. Test preparation hit and miss, first wake versus reattach, first correct full and discreet pixels, forced palette/geometry change and wrong cached key. SHADER/POST marker may precede correct pixels. Immobilize the next root traversal only after surface creation & sizing, hold legacy releases on the legacy control, and use current target A/C/B/A. Show that new motion continues without a further root traversal or custom released slot. A hook holding Main must not stop the fixture's sampler.
T3 Lifecycle: drive revoke before surfaceCreated, between creation/change, during shader preparation, between dirty notification and draw, during bounded holder submission, after post, repeated hide, same-root size change, rapid hide→new attach, service disconnect. Complete redraw callbacks exactly once even when canceled; assure zero holder touches after surfaceDestroyed returns and zero stale posts reaching a new target. Inject driver error and failed creation. Track worker/thread and bounded objects after cycles.
T4 Cadence/ownership: stable visible service interval with advancing correct content, no legacy pool or View-clock activation, no SurfaceView on the old-API/CARD route, no wakeups while fully hidden. Verify one worker and no backlog under slow consumers, stable resource counts, first distinct successor and A→B phase continuity. Withhold/delay one old message, supersede worker preparation and mutate old profile arrays to prove identity/copy defenses. Verify hide doesn't await compilation, a scheduled frame, diagnostic writes or an old custom fence.
T5 Privacy/compositor: independent full-screen composite with known fiducial, target bounds, two backgrounds and calibrated positive, missing, white, transparent, stale, wrong-color and wrong-phase controls. Sample the FIRST transition as well as later samples. Test full→discreet mid-frame, discreet→full with fresh authorization, cold/warm, settings change, hidden/show, race and resize on the actual service. Positive discreet appearance and absence of stale full detail are separate assertions. Unreadable targets cannot pass. Preserve old six R11 panel failures with their original route/expectations.
T6 Diagnostics: OFF/LIGHT/FULL parity, freeze while visible and after detachment, rotate capture while callbacks are pending, bounded CPU/bytes, critical tuples for failed and ordinary attempts, no invented physical endpoints. Console selector persistence and configured/effective modes, same selection after freeze, correct legacy field mapping.
T7 Host/production: detect wrong SHA/APK/source/ABI/mode, reused supposedly cold process, skipped or absent method, broken fiducial, uncovered target, wrong target bounds, missing first negative, all-white first real target, dead sampler, missing phase, failed teardown. Test that a red independent mode does not discard the other branches, reports, APK or graphs. Production service entry point and signed-equivalent profile behavior must be exercised alongside instrumentation.

14. IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT

A. Service and admission. Keep existing visibility classifier, system snapshot reader, exclusions, actual positive Main admission and privacy checks authoritative. Refactor the queue/dispatch boundary to allow exactly one safe speculative read, never speculative display. Publish an immutable Main-owned snapshot of detached/no-show-in-progress plus authority and freshness revision. Update it before operations that can attach, increase disclosure, revoke or change a relevant preference. Under queueLock, reserve the existing coalesced compatible B only after completed A is HIDDEN_UNKNOWN/NO_MAIN_MARKER with complete roots, no truncation, no stale flags, no contradictory/freshness escalation, detached state and matching generations. The reserved B uses its own event time, ID and current freshness obligations. No carryover markers from A. The reservation is eligible only when the current detached-negative policy with B present selects CONTINUE_PENDING with unchanged visibility epoch. Do not expand eligibility to ROOT_UNAVAILABLE or visible withdrawal.
Enqueue A's ordinary ordered Main apply and release only the one physical reader for B. One preceding ordered apply, one active/reserved read, at most one coalesced latest pending request; never build a queue of completed speculative answers or start C before A settles. Capture the reserved compatible follow-up ID for A's pending/retry decision, rather than losing it when removing B from pending. B may finish early; hold its result for ordered apply. At A apply compare the saved authoritative snapshot; on changed state, invalidate the result and reschedule any necessary fresh inspection under current identity via existing reconciliation. A's completion cannot clear B's reader slot; generations settle exactly once. Never hold queueLock across Android IPC or Main handoff. Current terminal/hide signals always revoke immediately, including while B is reading. An in-flight Binder read may finish after revoke; its result is discarded. Preserve full serial behavior whenever the proof conditions fail. All three candidate APK modes use this same gate. Only the deterministic A/B instrumentation changes this ordering for comparison.

B. Route selection and service integration. Introduce one explicit render selection at the actual eligible window/controller boundary: SURFACE_LIVE default, SURFACE_STATIC diagnostic, LEGACY_R11 diagnostic. Each visible lifetime snapshots configured and effective modes; do not mutate an active target for a console click. On hidden boundary install the newest selection and prepare the correct material before the next wake as possible. Add one three-option control in the existing Debug Console keyguard area. Return configured mode, effective mode and pending-boundary status, preserve across service restart for a comparison, allow restore to default with one tap. Use existing runtime monitoring MethodChannel in lib/core/diagnostics/keyguard_timing_capture_bridge.dart with new get/set handled in MainActivity. The capture commands that dispatch to IO must not mutate a Main-owned window there; serialize the setting and hand off on Main. No setting can grant eligibility or increase privacy. Limit mode overrides to diagnostic builds through a verified build-purpose/debug/profile gate. Default render mode must be visible in the frozen export and real packaged profile. Existing unsupported/API/static/non-target configurations take their existing compatible path. Candidate true/false eligibility is independent of receiving a debug command. Physically testable after normal install, without adb or choosing a hidden experimental toggle.

C. First image and material continuity. In the candidate standalone path replace old detached custom-buffer preparation with one worker-built immutable full-size poster, keyed by actual size/density, render configuration, canonical colors/effect/portal, visual variant, privacy and phase anchor. Before any disclosure always have a preparation path for the approved neutral variant. A prepared full variant may be held only where current settings and the application's data policy permit it; no financial text, screenshots, persistent pixel cache or synthetic expanded permission. Never bind FULL just because it is cached. Prioritize needed neutral+allowed active image; strictly bound to two current variant entries and one in-progress generation, superseded completions discarded; no unbounded bitmap-size or per-frame allocation. Prepare on service connection/settings/material/known target-size change and after legitimate withdrawal where necessary. Cache misses must not block Main, show authorization or teardown. Never animate while detached. Nothing predrawn into a live window while hidden.
Extract the ORB-only drawing primitives from KeyguardHeaderMaterialView, reusing KeyguardHeaderShader.configure(profile,width,height,time), KeyguardMaterialScene.timeAt/anchoredAt, canonical neutralized profile and existing static-gradient behavior. Preserve deep-drift/dual-tide/portal state, real palette, edge, continuity and the existing compatible material transition. Copy mutable profile arrays defensively; construct separate shader/Paint objects per worker usage and capture correct immutable commands for a cached frame. One implementation for drawing an ORB onto a hardware Canvas. Create poster by recording the same commands in an android.graphics.Picture on the worker and materializing Bitmap.createBitmap(picture,width,height,Bitmap.Config.HARDWARE) on eligible APIs; validate RuntimeShader/alpha/pixel identity with the on-device independent control. Do not draw RuntimeShader onto a software bitmap. Cap by the actual supported geometry and avoid per-frame readback. Isolate this offscreen preparation from a live target via its key, cancel obsolete work, and do not schedule it ahead of a currently authorized first frame. A missing/stale prepared image uses the current safe neutral poster if genuinely available and permitted; otherwise stay safely hidden/transparent until a permitted first image is ready. Record the delay, miss reason and first correct positive separately. Repeated missing images are a failed performance outcome. Never certify blank/neutral fallback as first correct requested FULL.
Both new modes post the same prepared image for the same authorized content on the same producer surface. For a given test seed, static holds that image with no animation ticks; live proceeds at the next worker display frame. On first display anchor the running timeline to the phase represented by the poster, not the arbitrary wall time at cold preparation. On real withdrawal freeze the last authorized phase for a compatible reattach; reconstruct a correct current poster for that anchor. Palette/privacy/size changes invalidate incompatible entries. Preserve the legacy semantics for continuously changing compatible profiles and the existing transition duration where applicable. For static mode, update on real allowed content/size changes and required platform redraws only. Correct neutral appearance is a positive visual requirement, including first transition pixels.

D. Draw and lifecycle. Main constructs the eligible SurfaceView and registers SurfaceHolder.Callback2 before attachment; use surfaceCreated/surfaceChanged/actual geometry plus explicit SHOW authorization in either arrival order. Main may install an inert child while the root is being built. Draw only when the current generation is authorized and a usable surface of the correct format/size exists. Use SurfaceHolder.lockHardwareCanvas and unlockCanvasAndPost from exactly one worker. Every frame fully clears transparent pixels and draws the true circle; honor the existing scene and alpha. On success, first and subsequent frames go to the same managed target; keep the queue platform-owned. Drive live motion by the worker Looper's Choreographer and actual frame times, one outstanding callback; coalesce obsolete frame demand. No schedule-ahead loop, Main invalidation pump, unbounded buffers, duplicate clock, or guessed fixed refresh rate. Profile lock/draw/post separately so a framework/driver stall is visible. Never derive future phase by adding a fixed amount per callback. Re-evaluate on surfaceRedrawNeededAsync, acknowledge its completion once after the correct operation or explicit cancellation. Callback completion is an OS lifecycle acknowledgement, not visibility proof.
Worker state: detached/prepared → authorized/waiting for surface → active static or active live → revoked → retired. The holder handle is owned for a single generation and not revived after surfaceDestroyed. Main can revoke immediately without waiting for draw or cleanup to initiate visual hide. Maintain an admission gate for in-flight holder access; worker enters only with the exact current token, leaves in finally, each successful lock is paired with one legal unlock/post even under exception, and no future lock begins after revoke. Prepare shaders, scene updates, diagnostics and other expensive work outside the holder critical interval. On surfaceDestroyed invalidate first; synchronize with completion of any operation that already entered so nobody touches that holder after callback return. Worker must never wait for Main or a main-executor callback during this interval. Do not time out and then access a destroyed surface. Record teardown wait and flag any long driver lock/post under §15. Coalesce callback completion without holding a monitor across an unrelated Main/Worker join. Service dispose removes frame callbacks, cancels queued target work, releases references and safely terminates worker after outstanding access drains. Hidden worker may retain bounded immutable preparation; no recurring callback/slot churn.
Use a distinct target generation and child instance across disclosure reductions. An old generation's late unlock, completion or callback cannot post to, uncover or unhide the replacement child. On a full→discreet downgrade immediately invalidate old permission and hide the old child at the window-owner boundary; show only a pre-approved locally prepared opaque-inside-the-circle discreet guard if necessary while a new target is created. It must preserve the ORB's correct transparent exterior and let no stale full content through the circle. Retire this temporary non-animated guard only after the current target has valid confirmed content and the visual handoff is coherent. Secure by actually withdrawing the old surface; do not rely on a transparent overlay hiding old pixels, on arbitrary sleep, or on treating post as proof of composition. Observe it on the independent compositor, including the first transition frame. If the required atomic visual/privacy contract cannot be demonstrated, record FAIL and return evidence rather than shipping a normal release. No second live renderer or pressure transition. Discreet→full always requires new positive authorization.
On material/driver failure record precise cause, stop recurring work, revoke the affected generation, present only an authorized canonical safe static image at the bounded root when available, otherwise withdraw. Label DEGRADED/UNAVAILABLE; this cannot count as successful SURFACE_LIVE or be silently converted to legacy. Re-attempt on the next genuine lifecycle/material generation only. Keep API/SDK checks at route selection, not inside every frame.

E. Hide. Keep display-off/unlock/exclusion and visible-UNKNOWN policies. For each true withdrawal the first Main operation invalidates authorization and makes the current root/child non-visible/non-interactive using the existing root visibility/window contract; cancel pending show, successor publications and subscriptions for that exact lifetime. Submit actual window removal promptly. Start/schedule resource retirement independently of visual withdrawal; entering platform surfaceDestroyed still obeys D. Do not wait for a render tick, compositor receipt, new tree crawl, timer, GPU preparation or cleanup before issuing local hide/removal. Do not defer required removal or change remove semantics merely to improve the return timestamp. Preserve actual decision, local hide, removal begin/return, and real surface destruction as different observations. Already-detached terminal cleanup is a separate event. Compare first usable event/callback to evidence that the last ORB pixels disappeared. Nothing in this plan promises availability of an earlier Android callback.

F. Debug Console and export. Use the existing dedicated reducer plus KeyguardExportBudget; implement compact per-attempt R12 summaries, versioned and parseable under the current UTF-8 byte budget (≤32 KiB). Give at least first retained cold, later warm/worst samples and all actual retained withdrawal rows priority over repeated verbose per-route UNOBSERVED fields. Preserve existing capture clocks/semantics, original omitted-attempt/critical-record/gap counts and actual omission identities; preserve an external untruncated trace in device suites. Store primitives in bounded rings off the hot path; no per-frame strings, disk writes or cross-thread wait. For OFF disable optional bookkeeping, for LIGHT retain route/outcome/timing, for FULL include the bounded worst examples.
Record service/process/wake/request/show/hide ID, privacy and surface generations, configured/effective route and degrade reason; callback & event time/source availability, inspection read queue/start/end, previous apply queued/entered, read-ahead eligible/reserved/rejected reason, fresh authority read, final SHOW, add, holder create/change/size, poster hit/miss/source/phase identifier (no financial data), worker demand/entry, first valid lock/post, first distinct successor, frame clock, lock/draw/post wall and thread CPU, root traversal marker separately, retire/revoke/remove/destroy and post-revoke rejections. Report first/last sample plus distributions, worst small bounded gap with frame and thread identity. Include true measured display period where supported. Uptime for app event joins, System.nanoTime for short monotonic spans, thread CPU for owned work. For cross-tool traces establish an explicit clock anchor and uncertainty. Distinguish submitted, committed when genuinely observable, target-layer latch/presentation when independently observable, correct composited pixels, and user-observed visual behavior. Missing means UNOBSERVED with reason. Do not relabel lock/post, PixelCopy(surface), screen-off or removeReturn as physical visibility.

15. PERFORMANCE GATE

For each mode report fresh-process first wake and each warm cycle individually, aggregate only equivalent cases. Record display refresh, process, API, geometry, palette/effect, exact source/hash, prewarm hit/miss, route, capture mode and interval class. Compare renderer modes with identical admission/scene/window/fixture. Separate (a) signal→positive SHOW, (b) SHOW→first correct composed ORB, (c) first→next genuinely distinct composed frame, (d) sustained locked cadence, and (e) actual event→callback→local hide→last externally visible ORB. Report event→remove return independently. Measure diagnostics overhead by comparing a matched LIGHT/OFF timing-only control to FULL; do not infer observer cost from cumulative consumer-lock duration.
Engineering acceptance budgets chosen for R12, not promises about handset physics: in a five-second continuously authorized, non-transition locked interval at the measured refresh, candidate frame submissions p95 inter-frame gap ≤2 display periods and zero unexplained candidate-owned gaps >50 ms. Report worst and counts over 2 periods/50/80 ms, plus externally measured cadence where coverage qualifies. SURFACE_STATIC should make no periodic submissions after its required first/redraw. For actual withdraw, target decision→local hide ≤1 display period on every measured repeat; report event-delivery and compositor portions regardless. For first correct positive pixels and first distinct successor, pair by environment/process state; report absolute bracket widths for new and legacy. A candidate is faster on a paired endpoint only where observation uncertainty supports the direction. Show mode-by-mode first-correct, last-visible and steady-motion results. If a late event/cold sample worsens, show it. Mechanism PASS alone cannot meet the product goal. No averaged-away cold start or fabricated p95 from four wakes.
Hold shared services/refresh equal. Separate automated stable 5 s locked and unlocked transition windows. Short screen recordings/sampling can disturb rendering; run timing-only and visual processes separately. Sample presentation timestamps or trustworthy compositor FrameTimeline entries for the matching layer, with layer mapping and observed data-source support; otherwise label absent. A static duplicate is not a newly animated frame. A real-queue cadence or cycle metric alone does not measure what the user saw. R12 remains open until the owner tests the exact APK.

Wire the three diagnostics modes and compact ownership evidence; port the full service entry and retain explicit legacy-mode tests. Validate cheap gates first. Run each fixed scoped device suite and capture all independent evidence, then eligible full gates and normal delivery. Build the exact-source Human APK and publish evidence even when independently possible after a failed gate. Never substitute another branch, older APK, a standalone test Activity or a screenshot-only prototype for the candidate.
