10. ROOT-CAUSE OR FORENSIC GATE

Selected hypothesis: serializing eligible inspection, host admission and creation of the first live buffer unnecessarily adds their elapsed times. Placing withdrawal behind normal apply/cleanup further extends a visible generation after current evidence rules it out. Redesign the dependency graph as specified. The first eligible system sample launches a single read and a neutral host preparation concurrently. A keyed image is prepared independently. Positive publication joins evidence, host, image and fresh system authority. A current negative seals the visible grant and submits hide immediately on the compositor owner. A slower tree can still impose a floor. No Android permission/API available to this product has established same-frame SystemUI scene notification on the Nothing A142.

Falsifiers: an adequately sampled, ready, correctly classified candidate still presents its first image as late as matched stock, continued forbidden pixels after a correctly targeted retire, a wrong-screen grant or lost first tap, or no reduction at the selected acquisition/host boundary despite real reachability. Return the exact phase and evidence to the reviewer. Never synthesize a visible time from first buffer, attach, fence or commit callback. Archive all raw outcomes including infrastructure/fixture failures.

14. IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT

A. One grant authority. Add K/KeyguardOrbPresentationCoordinator.kt for immutable ownership stamps and a small state reducer. Reuse existing session, wake, interaction, visibility, request, selection/route and profile revisions, primary display, disclosure and monotonic visual/host generations. Material revision includes palette, mode, dimensions and applicable data revision. Distinguish no host, inert host, host ready, grant pending, presented, revoke pending and retired using separate host and grant state. The staging stamp is never an admission. Service connect/settings changes on Main publish the immutable eligible route snapshot. A new eligible sampler result can reserve a provisional token under the same serialized ownership as the queue, schedule the one existing first tree work item directly on the existing reader, and post Main's bind/create-host action. Bind the matching provisional token exactly once as the real wake. Never relabel an older completed read with newer authority. A mismatch discards it and uses ordinary reconciliation. Carry stamped freshness/cache-clear obligation through actual read. Never inspect trees while general system/service eligibility is false. Do not call Android or View APIs under queue/authority locks.

B. The normal first physical active-root call on this route uses FLAG_PREFETCH_DESCENDANTS_HYBRID (4), which omits FLAG_PREFETCH_UNINTERRUPTIBLE (32). Keep accepted child flags 36. Select once per qualified wake at the actual physical call site after the reader's cache, primary-display, freshness and active-window checks. Preserve R16 identity verification, full window/child walk, child/per-window fallback, failure and retry rules. A cancelled reservation cannot steal another wake's first read. Revoke the option on incompatible revision. Record requested and reached flags, fallback and complete classification. Existing debug selector remains source-labelled and isolated from normal/profile. The R15 root-only argument 0 is not the candidate. A nonwinning first-read flag remains possible. Use stage timings and matched controls to distinguish it from the host change.

C. Prepare the image independently. On service connection with the opted-in eligible route, after first user unlock and valid profile, prime one immutable discreet first image using the existing canonical material/poster and phase model. A keyed current FULL image may be prepared from already-authorized immutable input for its exact disclosure; never initiate a financial query/bitmap bind to speculate. A valid positive grant can request missing FULL content through existing lazy flow. Do not briefly display a different class or replace the design with a generic dot. Use an idle worker to draw one correct RGBA buffer to a generation-owned hidden, unparented SurfaceControl and Surface where supported. Preserve transparent pixels outside the ORB. Keep no animation timer running offscreen. After a real grant continue from the existing animation time model with fresh motion; record first ready buffer, first new phase and sustained cadence separately. A preposted static poster by itself cannot pass the motion test. On reconnection, config or sign-out, clear incompatible data. An unshown, still-private matching buffer may become a generation's first image by a single ownership transfer. Neither a previously revealed child nor its compositor identity may cross a withdrawal.

D. Use the existing ordinary TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY window, existing size, bounds and interaction layout. At a fresh eligible wake start lightweight Main host preparation in parallel with the reader. Until grant its only content is a transparent, empty root of the correct geometry: no SurfaceView hole, poster, Flutter content, financial text, clickable subtree or spare visible layer. Keep FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE, FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL; stage with FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE, no exposed accessibility actions/content or visible animation. Never set an opaque color, translucent black placeholder or old view content. A system window can exist while this preparation runs. Grant eligibility, financial demand and capture attachCount still describe actual presentation. Add separate host counters. Avoid making a current window inert by reusing an old visible subtree. Obtain an exact own accessibility-window ID from the live surface/window attachment where available, guard it with current host generation and primary display. A title, timing, bare package or guessed ID cannot authorize ignoring a window. If own-window attribution is ambiguous and influences a scan, fail closed, tear down the inert stage, and use stock attach-after-positive for that authority under a fresh normal check. Suspend speculative host creation for that wake. Do not suppress real SystemUI changes. Terminal/ineligible transitions immediately disarm the token and remove the staged host; on inconclusive reads keep it only while the existing bounded wake/reconciliation is actually pending. No resident overlay/touch target persists on the unlocked phone, and no indefinite preparation on a locked idle screen.

E. On Main use View.getRootSurfaceControl().buildReparentTransaction(child) at valid attached geometry following KeyguardOrbBufferRenderer.ensureLayer. Transfer the returned owned transaction to the one compositor executor for a hidden bind only, close it after apply or discard. If starting unparented/posting is unsupported or host/size never becomes valid, cancel the generation and follow the existing safe authorized fallback. Retain stock as an explicit comparison/fallback, never show both paths. Use the ORB's local getLocationInSurface coordinates and crop, once: the WMS window already carries screen positioning. Do not apply a delayed visibility-raising transaction on a future View draw. Use public SDK APIs only. The code does not attach any pixels directly to the global display or a SystemUI window. This preserves system management of window bounds, gesture target, upper layers and window teardown. Docs: https://developer.android.com/reference/android/view/AttachedSurfaceControl#buildReparentTransaction(android.view.SurfaceControl) and https://developer.android.com/reference/android/view/View#getRootSurfaceControl().

F. Grant rule. Initial show, readmission and disclosure increase require a current complete MAIN classification, matching real wake, existing fresh final system sample and an exact eligible disclosure. Keep the existing final check at the point that publication becomes possible. If a positive preceded a genuinely delayed host/frame readiness, revalidate current authority and final system eligibility at publish, consume the applicable current classification/freshness obligation, and require existing reconciliation where intervening events invalidate that evidence. Never extend a permission by storing it across wake, terminal, disqualifying evidence, configuration or privacy change. Start input enablement on the actual authorized hosted root on Main and validate the exact active host, attachment/placement and WindowManager state before reveal. Ensure the first visible hit box and accessibility content have the correct current grant. Do not use a frame of visual lead over unusable input as a speedup. Normal animation work and input cannot raise visibility. One serial compositor owner elects matching prepared buffer + authorized input/host + current grant, immediately submits setPosition/crop/visibility once, and handles errors. A READY/commit callback only reports evidence. No worker, UI callback, stale poster or old scene can reparent a retired child. Test moves, detach/recreate, synchronous callbacks, target already prepared, late readiness and refusal.

G. Withdrawal rule. On a fresh terminal sample, screen-off/USER_PRESENT/disable, disconnect, or a current authoritative worker classification that the existing policy would withdraw, atomically seal the current grant, cancel its action authority and enqueue an exact-generation high-priority hide to the compositor owner immediately. Route both new and old Main paths through the same idempotent revoke. Do not wait for a normal Main apply, window removal, producer, draw, native borrower, diagnostic callback or commit receipt. A current negative may be consumed only for the authority/ordered read sequence it actually evaluated. Preserve ordered R12 reserved handling. An obsolete or future result cannot retire another generation. For a partially traversed tree only a positive observed credential/shade/occlusion marker already decisive under the stock classifier is an early disqualifier. Use the same verified primary system-window identity, node visibility and marker predicates. Continue the original scan for its reason/retry/accounting. NO_MAIN_MARKER requires its complete scan. Do not hide from a generic accessibility callback, a bare keyguard boolean or an unattributed package. Every R16 actual hide in this capture was NO_MAIN_MARKER. No early prefix gain is claimed for those rows. Keep genuine same-wake re-entry, new fresh proof and existing R14 selection/retry budget. For FULL → discreet, retire FULL immediately as policy requires, show only the correct new keyed image under valid authorization, otherwise remain visually empty.

H. Keep visual mutation ordered on one short-lived-task executor, separate from rendering, Binder tree reads, Main and diagnostic reduction. Publish checks the current grant immediately before submit; any externally received revoke invalidates it synchronously. If one submission already crossed the linearization boundary, the next transaction must hide that same generation before a later eligible generation can be shown. Never order an old show after its own hide. Revoke work cannot be buried under animation/metrics or arbitrary posted work. Do not hold locks across transactions, native calls or waits. Keep the ORB worker and bounded native borrow semantics. On revoke hide and unparent the exact child, stop new borrows, asynchronously dispose after current draw/PixelCopy leases drain. Keep at most one active/prepared slot plus one peer to prepare/swap or retire, at most two live native outputs in total. Under pressure promptly revoke retired content, skip staging until capacity returns, and never force-release an in-use handle or allocate unbounded slots. If normal native hide/unparent fails, invalidate permission, stop the producer, immediately request Main removal/hiding of the whole owned window and record the failure. The input path also stops new gestures/actions synchronously by grant identity, then disables touch/accessibility and removes the owned window on Main. Independently measure when actual touch-through returns. A late framework callback or stale Main teardown cannot affect the successor host.

I. Add fixed-size diagnostic edges for wake/system sample/reservation/adoption, actual read bounds/flags/cause, host add/attached/geometry, cold/staged buffer plus source phase, final admission, interactive host readiness, reveal/hide submit, seal, input disable, actual WMS removal and resource balance including fallbacks. Stamp exact session/wake/request/grant/host/output/operation IDs and actual disclosure. Keep uptimeMs for matching lifecycle and event callbacks, monotonic ns for paired native intervals, independent recording clock with measured alignment/uncertainty. For reveal/retire only, if supported, add API35 Transaction.addTransactionCompletedListener on a diagnostics executor; record transaction latch and valid signalled present-fence timestamp, missing/pending/invalid otherwise. Observe nonblocking and close resources. The fence can time a transaction, not identify its pixel contents. Keep commit receipt separate. Prefer a row per attempted wake with omissions counted to reprinting verbose duplicate blocks. Never add per-frame Main logging or financial payloads. See https://developer.android.com/reference/android/view/SurfaceControl.Transaction#addTransactionCompletedListener(java.util.concurrent.Executor,%20java.util.function.Consumer).

15. PERFORMANCE GATE

Set two distinct targets. Owner-facing stretch goal: at the first stable keyguard transition have the correct ORB within two measured refresh periods, and after exit leave the true underlay within two periods. Count from independently observed system transition frames, with brackets and sampling uncertainty. App-controlled design target on a ready warm path: at most one measured refresh period from the last required grant/host/image input to reveal submission, and from definitive exclusion receipt to withdrawal submission, including a deliberately occupied Main. At 60/120 Hz a period is approximately 16.7/8.3 ms. Report actual refresh for each run. Include any input-arming/setup delay between positive decision and last required input. A delayed prerequisite cannot make an artificially short “ready” metric pass the physical goal. A 100+ ms late first safe observation can still miss the owner-facing target. Do not make that delay disappear from the report.

Compare exact stock/candidate one initial + three warm wakes per process, counterbalanced stock/candidate then candidate/stock (4 processes, 16 planned cycles total), same route, real disclosure, device/profile, screen state and capture cost. Reuse valid archived data only for comparable measured endpoints. Keep every cycle, cold/miss and excluded pair with reason. Report raw times and matched per-case differences. With small N report counts/ranges and medians plus maxima, no reliable population p95 from three wakes. Per-frame cadence p95/worst with actual interval count is meaningful. Record SAFE sample time → complete tree → final decision, prepare/host overlap, decision → input-ready → first correct image → first visible motion, event → callback → verdict → seal → native retire → last old image/clean underlay, and time to actual input passthrough. Credit preparatory work only if it ceased to be on the hot path and the user obtained the correct image. Independent privacy/gesture/black-square/late-G1 failure is a failed release qualification.

8. CURRENT SOURCE FACTS

In K/FluviKeyguardCardService.kt refreshR18RouteOnMain and K/KeyguardCardWindow.kt prepareRetainedView/prepareR18 default to a discreet native output. KeyguardCardVisibilityPolicy first checks actual system/scene eligibility and then uses showFinancialDetails for FULL vs DISCREET. A preference cannot establish eligibility. prepareR18Decision requests a new output on a disclosure mismatch, uses replaceUnshown, drops the old output binding, and returns before the actual show. On missing prerequisites it also returns. maybeBindR18 unconditionally calls requestSystemCheck("r18Ready", evaluate=true) after successful hidden binding. r18ProofRequestId is scoped to one Main apply. An existing acceptable immutable scene observation has no continuation through readiness. R18 good behavior includes earlier single-reader start, one serial compositor writer, ordered terminal removal and an independent action gate.

KeyguardOrbR18Presenter.prepare seals its sole worker owner on every replacement. KeyguardOrbSurfaceWorker.prepareHiddenDirect allocates the Surface + target, builds/posters and posts while hidden. In reveal completion, successful transaction submission calls grantPresentation and schedules Choreographer animation. Completion here does not identify a physical pixel. Direct targets are constructed without the normal metrics reporter. R18 pipeline rows preserve neither direct first post-grant movement nor active cadence, and the reducer does not preserve every first positive/WAITING_INPUTS reason.

9. PROVEN / UNPROVEN / MISSING

PROVEN: 4/4 preposted discreet outputs went unused; 4/4 FULL outputs were created later and revealed. One retained request sequence makes the redundant-read mechanism directly observable. The final compositor submit is a small part of most recorded wake latency. Withdrawal submission promptly followed seal. Direct active-motion observability is missing in source. UNPROVEN: whether the earlier observation in any given historical cycle was still current at the later publish boundary, how much of the delay the fix will save, why attempt 1 spent 430 ms upstream and whether the reported lag also includes persistent animation jank. MISSING: authoritative ingress revisions/initial physical read and reason on every wake, exact contribution of output allocation vs poster generation, first actual composited motion and independently timed image removal. The four published reads used 36/36. The lost earlier data cannot establish that the one-time provisional 4/36 path never ran.

10. ROOT-CAUSE OR FORENSIC GATE

Hypothesis selected for this build: for initial FULL grant, treating the disclosed class as an already-rendered image before the scene decision creates unnecessary serial work. Replacing the prepared target and treating its readiness callback as a new scene event extends first appearance even when there was no external change. Separate native allocation/binding, proof, authorized first painting and publication. Apply directly as a bounded implementation. An exact fresher external event or new failed inspection may genuinely require another scan. If comparable direct FULL cycles eliminate these dependencies but the first correct image is still late, identify the measured outstanding interval and return the result to the reviewer. No further runtime remedy delegated.

11. SCOPE LOCK / NO-TOUCH

Initial admission only, on the existing API35 R18 direct eligible route, primary display, animated ORB/orbOnly/SURFACE_LIVE. Change the normal FULL-configured stage after first user unlock. Preserve the current fast preposted discreet route when settings request discreet. Same-wake reentry remains on its existing separate proof contract. Already-visible updates, downgrade, terminal exclusion and R18 early seal/retire stay protected. Keep static, legacy, fallback, CARD, disabled/reduced motion, other APIs, launcher widgets and visual design. Never build a FULL bitmap, shader configured with private palette/financial data, native FULL post, financial subscription or interactive surface from a preference alone. An empty carrier before authorization contains zero posted user frames and exclusively reserves geometry/graphics resources. A FULL-configured capture that actually permits discreet must select the legal class only under current settings/policy.

14. IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT

A. Define a staged output intent distinct from permission. Under the current post-first-unlock enabled API35 route snapshot, choose DISCREET_PREPOSTED when showFinancialDetails is false. When it is true choose EMPTY_AWAITING_DISCLOSURE. Intent is included in settings/route revision but never faked as an actual full/discreet frame. A changed preference cancels the stage. In KeyguardCardWindow.prepareRetainedView, cleanup-time preparation and refreshR18RouteOnMain, use a common selector so a late default prepareR18() cannot unexpectedly substitute a discreet child. Keep the existing application/project visual reference and dimensions. Split native ownership/allocated, hidden-bound, frame-ready with exact posted visual/disclosure, and revealed. Extend coordinators/receipts/tests that currently collapse these fields. Native output allocation may predate the wake exactly as the discreet resource does today. An unparented or bound blank has neither animation nor posted pixels, UI authority nor actions. Prepare only geometry, common shader/program resources and already allowed discreet poster data before proof. If the new native stage is ineligible/capacity constrained, enter the existing safe fallback once for that wake and report it.

B. Separate createDetached + hidden bind from prepareAuthorized + first draw. Create one virgin output and register its lifetime before a host exists; use one worker, one current owner, at most one retiring peer, as in R18. Host geometry and matching owner are sufficient for a hidden bind. Do not wait for imageReady to bind the blank. On the first complete, currently eligible class authorization, issue one class- and revision-specific paint request to the worker for that same virgin output. Use a dedicated immutable one-shot write ticket and the existing material/painter, size, palette, privacy visual key and initial phase. A successful worker unlock/post of the correct frame arms only that exact frame-ready bit. Do not label a zeroed surface, an older poster or allocation as a ready FULL frame. A valid receipt may reach Main synchronously or after a reconfiguration. Exactly one writer may activate a virgin output; repeating an identical request does not reset the target, post another first frame, revoke the host or allocate a second child. Only a later independent positive of the same disclosure/visual key may authorize revealing already prepared, still private, matching bytes. On terminal, expiry of an existing bounded wake, selection/privacy/data revision, write failure or new incompatible class, seal and drain the old output, use a newly identified permitted target as needed. Never repaint a previously FULL native child into discreet. Never resurrect a shown target. If a disclosure risk invalidates an in-flight full paint its result is kept inaccessible and disposed according to the existing lifetime rules. No bypass of stale-borrow or held-poster checks; no global GPU pool.

C. For initial eligible FULL mode add a one-use, non-displaying continuation owned by the actual host/wake. Construct it only from an original physical inspection with current complete MAIN, exact real disclosure, no root unavailable, truncation, stale result or ambiguous own window, R14 guards passed, and successful current system eligibility. It holds only scalar decision fields: request, reader ordering/freshness, current service/wake/visibility/interaction/attachment authority, selection/settings/privacy/profile/data/geometry revision, host/output intent, display and external-scene serial. No Android nodes, window objects, previous full scene or financial payload. Replace the temporary request-ID handover only for this initial continuation so it survives an apply return waiting for a genuinely missing prerequisite. The final publication and financial-demand side effects remain single-owner, Main-controlled and at most once. Do not call the original applyInspection twice to simulate a continuation.

D. External-scene serial. Track accepted potentially scene-changing external accessibility ingress on primary display (unknown provenance/display conservatively included), before handing it to the system sampler, queue, diagnostics or coalescing. Use the existing gate and exact-generation own-window identity. Display/session/system/config invalidation, contradictory current physical reads including HIDDEN_UNKNOWN while inert, new freshness obligations or newer ordered evidence invalidate an older waiting proof independently. Capture the relevant serial at actual physical read entry and compare at completion. A synthetic internal bind/ready or exact self-event is not an external scene change. A pending request ID or KeyguardInspectionFreshness.revision alone cannot prove scene stability. Keep ingress, authorization revocation and final submit linearizable using the coordinator's scalar lock or atomic generation. Never inspect Android objects, sample Binder, run callbacks or apply a transaction while holding that lock. Do not treat older read-ahead predecessors as newer scene truth. Coalesced newer events must invalidate even if no new physical read has started.

E. When frame, host and hidden bind are ready, consume one current continuation on Main. Recompute the actual disclosure from present settings and a fresh successful ADMISSION system read. Compare current scene/freshness and newer pending/in-flight work obligations, host identity, output, content and geometry; if a newer relevant read must decide, remain hidden and let the normal reader resolve it. At input arm, queueReveal and crossSubmitBoundary validate the same live continuation serial, extent, privacy and authority, including the coordinator's existing exact transition to attached authority. Replace a literal completeMainStillCurrent=true on this path with actual evidence; never let the legitimate self-attach revision invalidate its own grant or let that exception cover an unrelated revision. If invalidation wins before submit, prevent reveal and disarm/remove any input immediately through existing semantics. If reveal has crossed its boundary, existing priority retirement wins on current exclusion. Keep ordinary previously-ready immediate-positive and terminal behavior. No listener or renderer can independently grant.

F. Reconcile without a loop. A successful hidden bind is a host event, not a reason to request another tree walk when current proof or real work already exists. On eligible initial FULL, use a coalesced readiness notification (no tree) to advance the join on binder or first-post completion. Before the first result, preserve/wait for the active/reserved/pending normally required read; if all such work was cancelled and proof is absent, invoke the existing bounded reconciliation exactly once per unresolved scene revision, respecting its retry budget. After an invalidating event, use the ordinary existing ordered successor; if it is missing, request one normal current reconciliation. A timer, old proof or same read may not re-arm indefinitely. Under continuous events avoid starving the ordinary R18 immediate positive for a ready target. This optimization does not replace R14 readmission or pre-empt a genuine external event. Leave retry/cancel/finally and financial freshness contracts intact.

G. Diagnostics in the same APK. Record stable compact numeric per-wake/per-output edges: wake & SCREEN_ON, initial reserved vs actual physical first request, queue/read start/end/outcome/root flags/active-root and children, earliest complete positive and accepted disclosure, scene serial at read and consume, why an earlier positive expired or waited, host-ready, native allocation and bind, first authorized paint request and worker entry, painter/poster cache hit, draw/post return, grant, input, reveal, first distinct animated post after grant, active frame interval count/p95/max/>50ms, seal/retire/cleanup. Preserve original immutable identity during asynchronous delivery. Store first original request and positive even when a later request actually shows. Extend reduceR18 for these endpoints with explicit missing/overflow/suppression status and output bounds. Keep active cadence window starting at actual reveal/grantPresentation, never at a prewake poster. Use worker-local counters and bounded existing gap ring, publish summary at terminal/freeze, no per-frame Main formatting. Preserve OFF behavior and max export size, keep financial/private content out of telemetry. Distinguish sample start/finish and present fence from actual image class. Join uptimeMs lifecycle with calibrated monotonic ns for native/cadence clocks. A prerendered static image, first changed producer submission, and first correct moving screen pixels are distinct endpoints.

## 8. CURRENT SOURCE FACTS

Service advanceR19First issues KeyguardR19FirstPaintTicket only after a complete acceptable scene and a current system/authority check. KeyguardCardWindow → KeyguardOrbSurfacePresenter → KeyguardOrbR18Presenter.authorizeFirst → worker.authorizeDirectFirst validates and posts to the worker. prepareAuthorized chooses the initial or last compatible phase. getOrMakePoster validates size and on a miss constructs the scene and painter. makePoster records a Picture and calls Bitmap.createBitmap(..., HARDWARE). draw then clears the Surface and draws that bitmap. Subsequent live frames already prepare uniforms on the worker and call drawPrepared on a borrowed hardware Canvas. drawIfReady and first-post bookkeeping both assume currentPoster exists. Revoke with discardFull purges FULL posters for privacy. Preserve that policy. For animated variants KeyguardOrbSurfacePainter construction also calls KeyguardHeaderShader(context, ...) and the Android artifact reader loads metadata/source and constructs RuntimeShader. This real cost is included in the measured interval and remains in the proposed path.

## 9. PROVEN / UNPROVEN / MISSING

PROVEN: the old neutral-to-FULL swap was removed from the four exported first direct stages. Every one reports missPreparedOnWorker. Source establishes an intermediate image and a subsequent bitmap draw on this path. R19 three direct generations sustained worker motion; the fourth switched presentation routes. On attempt 6, 396 ms elapsed before the first retained full-positive result; host add alone spanned 117 ms and overlaps the acquisition path. The first returned FULL result expired in every retained attempt; the later consumed request IDs differ. This does not establish that the earlier decisions could safely have authorized a reveal. Three ordinary direct exclusions NO_MAIN_MARKER have seal → native retire apply return 2/2/1 ms (1/5/6); the fourth early retire took 1 ms on fallback. Holder termination was a separate event. No financial paints or legacy binds in the measured financial scopes.

UNPROVEN: share attributable to making the bitmap vs program construction, scheduling or GPU work; net gain after first direct GPU execution; cause of initial scene churn/Binder time; whether the fourth transient route switch was visible; physical cadence/privacy. A diagnostic consumer held its lock cumulatively for ~1.96 s; this cannot be charged as a Main stall. Faster producer submit may coexist with unchanged physical onset.

MISSING: system wake/unlock visual start, physical first/last correct pixels, trustworthy presentation fences and complete ordered raw ingress. On this APK firstPositive.readStart can be a later read. Do not label it the first physical read. The diagnostic child supplies separate first-read evidence.

## 10. ROOT-CAUSE OR FORENSIC GATE

H1 selected: the extra bitmap materialization and copy on the authorized FULL miss add avoidable serial work even though the target can accept the same painter immediately. Fix this one dependency. A stock miss with the exact ticket, real child, intermediate bitmap and completed first post is the structural RED. A baseline timeout, empty screenshot or wrong route cannot satisfy it. Falsification of the performance hypothesis: equivalent images with zero intermediate bitmap but no improvement in combined worker-entry → successful post/first acceptable screen sample in matched conditions. Report phase costs; do not select another renderer.

H2 registered: in invalidateR19Scene the service treats INPUT_ARMED with grant other than PRESENTED as pre-submit. crossSubmitBoundary occurs on the compositor thread while revealSubmitted is called from a completion posted to Main. In attempt 4 native apply returned by 3683, an ingress expiry is recorded at 3683, then sceneChangedBeforeSubmit/retire at 3684, despite no active direct posts. This source window can misclassify an in-flight/already submitted reveal. Same-millisecond ordering of ingress vs apply is unresolved. Req77 on WITHDRAWAL is the reservation ID used by failR18Stage; its SHOW_FULL is not a negative classification. Retain all evidence for separate reviewer decision. Do not soften ingress or retirement in R20. H3 registered: pre-positive delay dominates attempt 6, with a late retained positive read, host work and real scene changes possible; compare the separate first physical read in the newer base. H4: ongoing composition delay remains possible despite the three active worker series. A calibrated external image sequence distinguishes it. None requires a global refactor for this experiment.

For each stock/candidate exact path report callback → first physical read/first positive, worker queue, entry → painter ready → configuration → first post return, first post → grant → reveal apply return → first changed submission and available sampled pixels. Separate active gap p95/worst/over50, missed routes, prewake age, stale generations and actual withdrawal. UTF-8 report including footer ≤32768 bytes. Preserve raw evidence; diagnostic boundary emission is O(1) per first write, no new per-tick allocations/IO. Panel paired miss comparisons use the same configured shader, geometry and phase. Zero bitmap construction on the ticketed miss plus equal imagery is the structural gate. Report direction and individual timings; repeatable improvement in combined first-frame latency is required for the performance claim. If costs move into lock/post/GPU, the repair can be structurally correct with no speed gain. Flutter FrameTiming is N/A to this native Surface; do not convert worker gaps into screen FPS.

## 8. CURRENT SOURCE FACTS

Service shares queueLock with KeyguardFirstAuthorizedOrb and KeyguardOrbPresentationCoordinator. Before reveal it requires current proof, system eligibility, exact preparation/host/output and activation. The serial compositor checks the grant at crossSubmitBoundary, sets visibility, registers optional receipt, calls transaction.apply(), and reports the receipt when capture is enabled. The presenter may start authorized motion and posts done to Main. Only Main currently calls revealSubmitted, changing REVEAL_QUEUED to PRESENTED. invalidateR19Scene expires the scene and checks INPUT_ARMED && grant != PRESENTED. On an empty-awaiting-disclosure owner it can call failR18Stage, hideImmediately and the ordinary fallback recheck. That path deliberately labels the withdrawal with token.stamp.firstRequestId. It does not make an old positive inspection an exclusion. The normal non-own accessibility event still undertakes its independent classification and read. readInspection and onDecisiveSystemMarker can seal an exact direct output from the reader before Main reconciliation. A fallback holder uses its own R16 retirement and host lifecycle. The two routes need separate counters and timestamps.

## 9. PROVEN / UNPROVEN / MISSING

PROVEN: the publication and Main grant transitions run on different lanes; the source accepts a destructive ordinary-ingress interleaving after successful submission. R19 has one matching recorded ordering. Three of four retained R20 attempts contain two distinct show/attach episodes with a real removal between them. R20's first FULL image optimization passed an independent calibrated panel. The final event was already 105–116 ms old when its callback arrived on this handset. Original direct rows were dropped from this export by allocation priority.

UNPROVEN: H1, this post-submit/pre-ack interleaving contributed to the reported R20 flicker and delayed stable appearance. H2, one or more short first episodes followed an actual pre-cross/in-flight change, true exclusion, failed reveal or another failR18Stage reason. H3, initial access to framework windows is a separate show delay. First reservation reads on 1/7/8 lasted 256/219/188 ms with active root 112/126/105 ms and first child 92/70/69 ms; attempt 7's old result was ROOT_UNAVAILABLE. The first show decision is already late even before teardown. H4, upstream notification timing and later scheduling/inspection explain part of final hide. Event age does not establish whether Android delivery, Main work or both caused it. H5, compositor/display timing or intermittent animation gaps are still possible. Three later holder streams give no >50 ms producer gap. The diagnostic consumer aggregate is insufficient for Main-thread attribution.

MISSING: exact R20 direct method, actual native ordering, first frame/physical flash, time of first decisive external exclusion, actual last pixel and SystemUI animation onset. R20's replacement request IDs and adjacent timestamps cannot establish the triggering event or prove three optical flashes. Separate earlier same-wake withdrawals, final actual withdrawal and already-detached cleanup in all tables.

## 10. ROOT-CAUSE OR FORENSIC GATE

Choose H1 for repair. There is a specific production interleaving, an older handset specimen with a post-submit fallback, and a repeated cost with an independently observed new host. Predict that a qualified native apply, delayed Main acknowledgement and ordinary ingress returning fresh SHOW_FULL will keep the same host/output; same-wake fallback count for that sequence goes from one to zero. A true negative must still retire the child in either order. If a fixed handset's compact evidence shows withdrawals occurred before crossing, while applying, after a hard exclusion, or with a different reason, H1 fails for those episodes. If verified H1 disappears yet lag continues, return the remaining per-stage intervals to the reviewer. Do not substitute another architecture or widen authorization. No gated speed estimate can eliminate the independently observed upstream delay.

## 11. SCOPE LOCK / NO-TOUCH

Only the R19 empty/full direct handoff, its narrow contention with ordinary accessibility ingress, and its bounded diagnostic/export/test coverage. Preserve R20 DIRECT_MISS and BITMAP_HIT, materials, phase, geometry, shader, motion, cache purge, financial disclosure, gestures, user settings, two-output bound, old owner drain, legacy and holder routes. Preserve home widget, dashboard milestone 6e962187e90e2a82431b1f91b224d2b52a6e0ba7 and Flutter UI. No notification timeout, grace window, event-type exemption, delay, sleep, guessed unlock, global event suppression, polling, new renderer, preauthorized FULL, reuse of an expired proof, always-on tracing or arbitrary frame-rate cap.

## 12. LAYERS / BOUNDS / OWNERSHIP

Main owns service, View/host, WindowManager, interaction and lifecycle. Reader/sampler may revoke from the existing validated boundaries. Compositor owns transaction, apply and ordered exact-child retirement. Render worker owns Canvas/phase and borrows only its exact target. Keep original service/wake, reservation, reveal sequence/proof, attachment, host/output identity and capture bindings. Add bounded per-entry scalar state only. Scalar transitions share queueLock. No Android APIs, test barrier, trace formatting, dispatch, diagnostic callback or native apply under that lock. Publish outside-lock observations with captured IDs. No changes to release waits, capacities, renderer cache or cleanup policy.

## 14. IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT

1. Extend the existing coordinator Entry with a per-reveal submit phase and a monotonically ordered scalar transition number (same entry). Reset on a new permit and retirement, compare the current reservation, exact host and output, reveal sequence and grant proof before mutating. Keep ordinary Main grant acknowledgement as its existing separate transition. crossSubmitBoundary keeps all existing proof/authority checks. Add markNativeApplyReturned(permit) callable solely at the successful native return. It may publish once for a matching crossed, uncancelled, still-queued permit. It cannot create a grant, set a host visible, advance interaction or read a View. Keep the original interaction rule: a lawful same-owner interaction after crossing differs from a stale authority before crossing. Ineligibility or seal always wins. Seal must remain possible after marking a pending entry cancelled, and must reap only its original output/host.
2. Thread an explicit applied callback through KeyguardCardWindow.revealR18 → KeyguardOrbSurfacePresenter.revealR18 → KeyguardOrbR18Presenter.reveal → KeyguardOrbPresentationLane.reveal. Invoke the scalar callback immediately after transaction.apply() returns successfully, before any receipt reporting, closing the transaction, starting motion, or posting Main done. Cross/queued/commit/fence are distinct. Pass the exact captured permit through the closure. Keep raw native success distinct from acceptance by the coordinator. Failure or handler.post refusal cannot set applied. If a crossed permit was concurrently cancelled, do not activate motion for it; its original ordered retire still runs. No blocking Main/compositor handshake. Update the panel's existing direct callers with explicit meaningful callbacks; avoid a default no-op that accidentally bypasses production accounting. Keep non-ticket direct behaviour compatible. Scope the new ingress exception to EMPTY/FULL.
3. On Main use one synchronized(queueLock) scalar operation to expire the previous firstAuthorizedOrb proof and classify the captured owner at the same ordered point as the mark above. Retain the existing own-window/display eligibility at the call site. Decision table below. Release lock before Android cleanup, normal inspection dispatch or diagnostics. The proof always expires on existing qualifying ingress; keeping an already submitted child gives no reusable permission to present another image.

| At the scalar decision | Ordinary external accessibility ingress with normal inspection | Safety/control |
|---|---|---|
| No matching owner, unarmed or no exact attachment | Existing invalidate/recheck path | Stale G1 cannot touch G2 |
| Armed, no successful submit published, including crossed/in flight | Atomically record cancellation for this exact pending reveal before releasing lock. Execute original failR18Stage/ordered hide and fallback once | Old cross/publish/ack cannot revive it. If native work is in flight, hide/unparent immediately on that lane after it. Never declare no pixels |
| Successful exact submit already published, Main ack pending | Keep that exact child and let acceptAccessibilityMetadata continue normal fresh system/window evaluation | No fallback, detach or new reveal solely for this ordinary event. Do not pre-approve the successor. An actual current exclusion still seals immediately |
| Already acknowledged, revoked, retired, foreign output or duplicate | Use existing acknowledged recheck or existing idempotent retirement/ignore as appropriate | No second authority transition, hide or activation |

Keep DISPLAY/SYSTEM invalidation, screen off, user present/unlocked, hard sampler exclusion, decisive marker, actual current inconclusive/negative while armed, privacy downgrade/settings/route change, interrupt and teardown at least as restrictive as stock. Apply the new exception only where normal external re-evaluation is available; if that continuation cannot be admitted keep the conservative withdrawal. Mechanically return the offered request ID (nullable) from scheduleEvaluationCommon through scheduleEvaluationFromIngress after the existing queue offer. Both an active offer and a pending/coalesced offer count. Existing Unit-return scheduleEvaluation callers may discard the result. In acceptAccessibilityMetadata, if beginOrJoinWakeCycle or that offer fails on the special pending-ack path, retire only the still-matching exact owner. Correlate a later replacement using its actual queue identity. Do not add a second inspection where an existing one was admitted. Keep sealR18's current-authority and minimum-proof checks; do not relabel a reservation's original read as the exclusion. Keep readInspection's ability to detect visible-or-armed while cancellation is pending. Recheck atomically by exact identity in Main done. On accepted native return, acknowledge only that exact live permit once; on late cancelled/replaced/sealed/duplicate done do nothing to current owners. Current genuine failure follows the existing exact cleanup with a real reason. Natural preemption after native return but before the scalar publication is conservatively classified in flight. Do not claim atomicity across Android and Kotlin or add a timeout.

4. Preserve evidence on the existing Android diagnostic worker. Capture bounded scalar snapshots at cross, at native apply publication, at the first decisive ingress in the armed/ack window, at Main acknowledgement and at seal/fallback. Bind each to capture ID, service/wake, reservation id and original request, grant/paint proof IDs, host/output/attachment and reveal sequence. Carry native observed uptime and the coordinator ordinal through delivery; observer arrival order and a same-ms tie cannot establish ordering. ## 15. PERFORMANCE GATE

Primary structural outcomes are zero erroneous post-submit fallbacks and one host/output on a qualified stable positive sequence, and preserved immediate exact retirement on a real exclusion. Report lossless denominators for every attempted slot, separate initial vs warm, Direct vs holder, fallback vs single host. Report wake→first positive, first decision, native submit, first confirmed correct sample and first distinct post. For hide report event→callback, callback→read finish, handoff→Main, first authoritative exclusion→seal/retire, local hide and remove return. Distinguish absence, invalid clock, timeout and not-applicable. Separate uptime, System.nanoTime, any fence clock/alignment and physical observation. Retain producer/consumer costs, gaps, posts and dropped/exported records. No subtraction across unlike endpoints, no speed claim from one panel sample, an earlier show decision, one optical frame, or incomplete phone records.

Bound the focused phase to one stock and one candidate block for deterministic orderings, one stock and one candidate eligible panel block, and one positive and one negative actual-service fixture per arm. If real direct route, independent panel/scene calibration and comparable configuration qualify in both arms, use a single AB/BA comparison, four fresh processes, each one first + three warm wakes (16 planned); include every failure. Report raw per-slot and median/range with sample size. A failed real-service admission is a failed precondition and gives no permission to perform 16 fallback-only cycles. Fix at most one verified mechanical fixture defect per failed boundary with new evidence; no retry-to-green.

## 8. CURRENT SOURCE FACTS

At ef310b49 the sampler can reserve a request and launch the single reader before Main adopts the exact generation. inspectSurface snapshots the firstAuthorizedOrb scene immediately before readSystemWindows. The initial API35 root strategy is interruptible hybrid (4) on the eligible call; accepted child prefetch is batched (36). Actual initial flags are available on attempts 1/3/4 only. KeyguardWindowSnapshotReader.read/visibleIds checks authority before/after framework access, enumerates relevant default-display windows, verifies own identity and rejects missing/truncated results. In contrast to scene validity for a FULL proof, authorityIsCurrent tests wake/session/visibility/interaction/attachment including provisional adoption. A non-own event can advance sceneSerial, invalidate a proof and queue a newer real read without changing this authority. firstAuthorizedOrb.requireRead also records a newer read obligation. The old traversal may continue to acquire children even when it can no longer produce usable FULL evidence. A normal completed read usually awaits Main apply before inspectionQueue.complete releases pending; R12 is a tightly delimited exception for a completed negative. traceAbortedInspection posts a reconciliation check, so a deliberate scheduling handoff needs its own outcome. R21's pre-/in-flight cancellation and current negative seal apply at a later or different boundary.

## 9. PROVEN / UNPROVEN / MISSING

PROVEN: the delay is present on a successful direct backend. Each first read lasted 149–227 ms. For 1/3/5 the physical first read returned MAIN/FULL, yet each final grant used a different request. For 4 the first complete read found no main marker and a fresh read was required. Request 89's callback arrived at 1245228426, was offered around 8427 (queued timestamp) and physically started at 8431, after request 85 finished at 8430. This documents overlap with the old read's tail, and limits the potential saving from that particular late arrival. Reads for the final winning grants ended at 245–459 ms from wake. Submission after them took a further 10–47 ms. No recorded post-submit fallback or multi-host recovery explains these four waits.

UNPROVEN H1 (selected): some wake-opening walks continue making remote acquisitions after a fresh external successor makes their positive result unusable. This can postpone the next useful complete read. For 1/3 the first-positive trace reports read/current scene serials 44/54 and 153/161; the latter serial was sampled during recording, not a timestamp for the precise first change. For 5 the verbose row is absent. No estimate of saved milliseconds from these differences. H2: the first root/platform calls, missing genuine MAIN, or repeated real SystemUI transitions dominate before any safe opportunity; R22 cannot shorten an already running call or make the OS expose MAIN sooner. H3: host readiness (notably attempt 1) and fresh certification after paint overlap; only measure critical-path intervals. H4: painter construction is a real 24–30 ms component in the measured rows but cannot account for the bulk. H5: upstream event age and physical compositor timing can matter on hide; the observed native retirement after seal is already 1–2 ms. H6: diagnostic overhead is observable (producer max 12.25 ms), without attribution of the cumulative consumer lock time to Main or to these windows.

MISSING: per-wake first eligible real successor offer relative to the first root/child calls, existence of cooperative boundaries afterward, precise reasons each potential proof was rejected or coalesced, actual compatible queue promotions, physical system/overlay onset or removal. Keep the hypotheses separately falsifiable. The old post-submit race is unexercised in these four records.

## 10. ROOT-CAUSE OR FORENSIC GATE

Choose a bounded scheduling repair on acquisition; do not rewrite the renderer, guess the system scene, or globally switch prefetch flags. In a controlled eligible A→B ordering stock continues A's obsolete work; candidate should cease issuing further A acquisitions at the first eligible checkpoint, run one complete fresh B and advance the correct-frame endpoint when that work was on the critical path. If natural observations show no B before a useful checkpoint, B still loses to a later C, B is slower than completing A, or correct-frame time does not improve, record that finding. Do not expand cancellation to later walks, skip real exclusions or tune timers in response. Return the acquisition/host/paint/permission split to the reviewer. Neither the handset nor the previous emulator has yet established that this is the principal fractional saving.

## 11. SCOPE LOCK / NO-TOUCH

Only the initial, still-unpublished empty/full direct reservation at API35, the reader handoff and its evidence. Keep one physical reader; keep wake/attach bounds, cache invalidation, inactive-window checks, marker coverage, traversal completeness, foreground/display and final fresh system policy. Preserve R19 full authorization, R20 direct miss/exact hit/phase, R21 submit/ack and negative-seal ordering. Preserve actual unlock/occlusion/shade/credential exclusions, discreet, static, legacy, home widgets, dashboard, gestures and accessibility behavior. No new window, speculative FULL image, reader pool, cross-wake cache, debounce, new retry, speculative early show or new permission. A device-locked bit alone cannot establish a visible main lockscreen (Android KeyguardManager.isKeyguardLocked also covers an occluded keyguard).

## 12. LAYERS / BOUNDS / OWNERSHIP

Main owns servicing external events, host/view and actual apply. Sampler only reserves and may exclude. The inspection coroutine owns framework objects and their local stack through the return of each blocking call. queueLock protects scalar queue/token transitions and ordering with freshness/authority. No Binder call, diagnostic formatting, View read, blocking probe, Main dispatch or waiting under that lock. A in flight, one coalesced pending successor, and one existing optional completed R12 predecessor are the existing limits. R22 is disjoint from that predecessor. One successful yield per original reservation, only for its first physical request ID. Use Main-published and coordinator-owned scalar facts. Never inspect a View, Main-only paintRequested or mutable Main state directly from the reader thread.

## 13. REQUIRED RED TESTS

T1 — stock/candidate deterministic A/B/C. Hold the production reader at a debug safe checkpoint after the first root/first child has returned and before the next child access. Offer a distinguishable newer real-metadata B through normal ingress while A is held; identify the real queue offer, then release. On stock observe a subsequent actual A child/root acquisition with B pending under the same authority. On candidate B starts via the same worker before any additional avoidable A call. Test an earlier yield before active-root acquisition too. Do not infer a RED from missing new telemetry. Freshness debt not yet established, established, newer revision during pending work, missing/failed root, unknown own identity, decisive marker before checkpoint, complete last node with no work left. A cancelled A must never offer paint/consume proof, show, hide a successor, emit a synthetic negative or clear new debt. ## 15. PERFORMANCE GATE

Primary user endpoint: app wake callback→native reveal apply return on a direct, correct FULL episode, plus first distinct worker post and an independently sampled correct composite where available. For a true optical claim, align independent system/ORB video or validated display evidence; identify first correct sample vs physical light. Secondary: B offer→B start, last avoidable A acquisition, number of physical calls and complete reads before the actual grant. Report all outcomes by initial/warm position and route, including no-yield, genuine rejection, timeout, fallback, wrong scene and no usable episode. Keep denominators across all slots. The medians of these four R21 observations are 392 ms to native reveal return and 404.5 ms to distinct post. They are descriptive, not a paired control arm or a promise.

Use one comparable stock/candidate AB then BA block if both real-service arms reach the intended lockscreen. Four processes on the same host/device, one initial plus three warm wakes each, 16 slots planned. Retain individual data and initial/warm medians, range, and worst, label tiny samples. No matched performance result if the actual direct/scene/calibration prerequisite fails. To label a material improvement for this experiment require at least 50 ms lower median wake→native return across comparable direct wakes, consistent direction in both block orders, correct visibility/animation and no evidence of worse withdrawal or greater fallback/failed-wake count. This is a reviewer decision threshold, not an Android guarantee or a reason to drop failures. Report smaller advances as small; insufficient comparability as NOT ESTABLISHED. A controlled reduction of calls alone is structural progress only. If the phone remains slow, retain whether stale work was actually avoided and how much time elapsed before the first eligible checkpoint/after its successor; do not ask the owner to rerun a previous build merely to obtain the next repair.

## 16. IMPLEMENTATION ORDER

Pin source, take stock T1 and normal stable/negative controls using the actual acquisition/queue path. Implement exact handoff, cleanup, no-op guards and evidence in the same coherent candidate. Run cheap compile/JVM/consumer tests before spending hosted emulator/full CI. Use one candidate targeted run for T1–T4 and stock control on the compatible hosted runner; separate fixture-only correction from application changes. Once a coherent candidate containing the repair and evidence builds, passes cheap checks and structural safety controls, promptly verify/deliver the experimental signed phone bytes while independent qualification continues. If structural tests expose a wrong grant, lost exclusion, disposal bug or wrong-generation queue transfer, withhold the affected build pending correction/reviewer decision. A fixture failing to reach a direct route is not a product acceptance result. No open-ended cause-finding task.

## 13. REQUIRED RED TESTS

T1 R1. Add r22CalibrationPreservesNonSuppressingAutomation to the existing service fixture driver. In a fresh invocation capture registration flags, service-enabled/bound state and number/owner of acquisition calls across real calibration, teardown of the reference activity, enable and the existing connection condition. On unmodified instrumentation reproduce the flag contract RED (archived positive log is the primary baseline); apply just the test patch to the exact parent target APK and execute the corrected witness once. Record independent connection, original A entry and first actual child acquisition as separate steps. No test can pass by injecting a synthetic service, relabeling a later request or observing a different window.

T2 R2/R3/R5. Reuse the real three-publication R08 pressure reproducer with original slot/use and ticket sequence. Generate independent fixed-phase FULL, neutral bootstrap and no-ORB references at the same geometry, density and background. Capture them in a separate setup that restores the specimen state. Preserve the archived red sample as comparator. On the candidate run the unchanged, unheld six-sample sequence from its original boundary. Add a separate deterministic owned-root test, isolatedOpaqueOrbHasNeutralParentAtRetire: after an actual FULL composite with bootstrap retired, use a one-shot test-only pre-draw listener to defer the next root traversal across the real retire and first screenshot. In this discriminating case confirm the exact native clear/commit receipt independently before sampling, so the capture is of the exposed parent. An absent receipt or an expired test hold is NOT REACHED. Allow main/worker, screenshot and native retire to run; no blocking the UI thread, new app grant or synthetic release. Arm before downgrade. Release the listener in finally, with a bounded external watchdog and failure on timeout. No hold in the acceptance or performance strip. Check the temporary image against independent calibrated neutral interior and known contour, compare complete background, and require the normal unheld strip to satisfy the original material/old-FULL guards. A missing observation never passes. Keep all samples, including initial failures.

T3 R2/R3/R4. In isolatedStandbyPreservesAuthorizedComposition compare opaque FULL reference to guarded FULL at the same A/C/B/A phases using current project thresholds. Check exterior and the AA ring over white and a second distinguishable test background using fixed off-ORB marks. Compare on/off with a semitransparent profile, and an update from opaque to translucent and back, a crossfade, and resize. Verify unchanged composited FULL/alpha, actual bounds, taps and window count. Verify inactive/detached standby draws zero; ordinary backend first post and advancing phases remain the observed source. Compare neutral interior against its calibrated reference, not just “different from FULL”. A clipped edge is a reportable failure if visible metrics exceed the independently predeclared band, not permission to widen a threshold.

T4 R4. Exercise original privacy→stale FULL ticket→resize→stale old-size neutral ticket, fresh neutral, pressure recovery, stop/dispose, immediate unlock/disconnect and hide while the child first-commit callback is pending; old-owner callbacks after a new wake must not re-arm the paint. Assert exact route, same lease/slot upper bound, genuine release/fence counts, no old FULL, no visible ORB on terminal underlay, and unchanged hide submission order. Include downgrade before any standby frame is known to have been submitted; record outcome and maintain existing privacy and continuity gates. No waiting to retire for coverage. Keep the original R08 assertions for all later stages.

T5 R6. Run the existing positive, stable, post-claim exclusion and untreated real-service methods; see section 17. Preserve actual original A→B, C occupancy and displacement; independently correlate authorization and the actual owner of the rendered phase or hidden image. Require one real reader, no obsolete grant, stable A completing when no relevant ingress intervenes and exact negative retirement. Keep deterministic reader/post-claim exporter and LIGHT/FULL restart cases. Record misconfigured harness, NOT REACHED, functional failure and visual failure separately.

## 14. IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT

1. Obtain exactly one explicit UiAutomation with FLAG_DONT_SUPPRESS_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICES per service-fixture invocation. Inject that handle into KeyguardR22VisualCalibration(instrumentation, directory, automation). Change screenshot() to automation.takeScreenshot(); use the same handle for every calibration, post-show, exclusion, shell, permission and window read in that invocation. Instrumentation remains responsible for Activity/Main scheduling. Remove transitive default getters from this path. Keep separate panel instrumentation invocations isolated and keep their existing flags. Compare requested flags with actual platform registration log/dumps before and after, restore permissions, enabled accessibility services, settings, screen, debug hooks and reference Activity in finally.

2. Add one passive paint state to the existing root with attachment, lease generation, target view reference/size and safe geometry. It holds no presentation, profile, bitmap, service or worker strong reference beyond the main-owned live view/identity. Configure it from the controller when an authorized, attached eligible lease is selected (reconcileIsolatedOrbTarget/onAttached), before removal of its original visible bootstrap; keep the original INVISIBLE transition for that View on exact first commit. If layout is pending, arm on matching layout before drawing, verify dimensions again in dispatchDraw. Draw only if the validated state is current. Use normal root invalidation only for actual state changes. Do not make the root neutral while awaiting first grant. Fallback if the root lacks this capability is the current renderer behavior.

3. On FULL→discreet, allow the last already-submitted neutral backing pixels to remain in the parent buffer while immediate child revoke/clear/hide and publication of the permitted full-size neutral View proceed via the existing code. Clear the stored standby once the normal permitted View takes over in the next coherent parent traversal; clearing bookkeeping cannot erase a previously submitted frame. Never reference the old FULL scene to paint the standby. On genuine hide, route/owner change, transform/size change, failure, detach or dispose clear any future standby draw for that identity immediately. On resize a fresh lease rebuilds geometry. Check commit tokens and current root/attachment before any deferred update. On nonopaque/profile transitions do not expose old guard content underneath a newly translucent child; use the current authorized View/bootstrap during that transition, retire an incompatible old child by the existing ownership path, and use a guard-free parent submission before allowing a replacement translucent child over a previously guarded parent if their submission can race. This rare transition may gate a new child, never old output retirement. Tag the callback by exact identity; cancellation switches to the existing permitted View until a genuine new child is available. No waiting on UI, no disabling the ordinary View to pass.

4. Keep the same normal six screenshot positions and immutable section-13 controls. Register the parent commit observer on Main before invalidation/traversal (old test registered it inside onDraw), separately tag the observed draw and matched callback. Bound receipts by test epoch/root/attach/lease/draw sequence; record missing/late/other-frame receipts explicitly. A frame-commit receipt or child apply return is not a physical pixel timestamp. Instrument which parent role was actually drawn (standby/ordinary neutral/full bootstrap/none), geometry and privacy, without user data. In the same Human build add a small typed snapshot to K/material/KeyguardCardMaterialController.attachmentRenderSummary / KeyguardAttachmentRenderSummary and export with the existing K/FluviKeyguardCardService overlay.attachmentRenderSummary consumer. Include backend, eligibility/reason, attachment/generation, first passive draw uptime and last exit reason; use explicit unavailable for direct-route or unseen draws, skip capture-only bookkeeping with capture OFF, and preserve older persisted reports. If the record is omitted under pressure, name that omission. The actual repair must work with diagnostics OFF. Detailed traces and PNGs belong to instrumentation. At most one active owner and a small fixed event budget per transition. Keep diagnostics OFF functionally equivalent. No synchronous I/O or scene formatting on the render path.

5. Store a full same-frame screen, ROI, calibration hash, geometry, root/child/lease, screenshot interval, old child hide begin/return/receipt, neutral draw/receipt and independent reference classification per sample. Use the existing meaningful()/nearlyEqual() interior thresholds, and exact outside-ROI invariance on the controlled static panel. For the standby contour, compute the allowed image from the independently drawn fixed neutral gradient clipped two physical pixels inside the calibrated circle on that actual background; compare the full ROI including the ring against this expected standby or canonical full-size neutral with the original per-pixel tolerance. Never mask the ring from both comparisons. Matrix outcomes include OLD_FULL, SAFE_STANDBY, SAFE_NEUTRAL, BLANK, UNDERLAY_AFTER_HIDE or UNCLASSIFIED. Count a background-only ROI as success only after a real terminal hide. Keep input and UI controls separately identified from output evidence.

## 15. PERFORMANCE GATE

W-SHOW: split callback→queue→A first Android read→actual B arrival/claim→successor classification→authorized reveal apply return→first distinct post; record actual IDs, saved acquisitions, new IPC and worker wait. W-HIDE: retain original event-time→callback→first decisive result→seal→retire return/receipt→root removal, excluding terminal no-op. W-LOCK-ANIM: actual phase changes, p95/worst producer gaps, >50 ms, generations/fallback and blank strips. W-HOME-ANIM and Flutter frame timing: outside this runtime change; report protected controls and N/A on native-only timing. Count parent traversals and allocations, passive draws and producer cost with capture OFF vs LIGHT. Compare cold first session and warm wakes, cached and uncached first frame. Root history must show zero self-scheduled animation on the standby.

Use the existing untreated AB then BA protocol only when both sources produce comparable direct episodes on the same host. Four fresh processes × (one initial + three warm), 16 planned slots, retain all failures, no scheduling holds. Pre-existing criterion: at least 50 ms lower comparable median to reveal apply, improvement in each order and no worse withdrawal, continuity or additional failed/fallback wakes. R21 phone median 392 ms is descriptive. Neither the held stock witness, synthetic unit time, R08 screenshot latency nor 1674/1863 ms R22 emulator submissions can be substituted. Missing comparable slots → report insufficient evidence. A phone verdict needs same-device evidence and the owner's observation.

## 15. PERFORMANCE GATE

W-SHOW: wake callback, A actual root/first edge, B offer and exact claim, grant, first authorized buffer and native reveal apply; split wait from painting. W-HIDE: event time, callback, decisive classification, seal, native retirement and local remove; distinguish attached hide vs cleanup no-op. W-LOCK-ANIM: exact visible phase changes, first motion, gaps p95/worst/>50 ms, PUBLISHED/WAIT states, skipped eligible translucent steady ticks, accepted releases and standby traversals; fixed-size, cold/warm and alpha-transition controls. W-HOME-ANIM unchanged, do not equate Flutter performance with native compositor or launcher timing. A paired no-pressure translucent steady control is essential to guard the two-use rule: same emulator/profile/phase, same observation duration and at least 100 actual distinct baseline and candidate producer intervals where reachable. Preserve all slots and report actual frame count, median/p95/worst gaps, >50ms and observed phases. Require continuous distinct movement, no new >50ms stalls vs paired baseline and no systematic loss of cadence (predeclared median and p95 tolerance one display interval at the actual refresh rate). Capture OFF/LIGHT producer and per-draw overhead separately; no extra Android acquisitions, frame logs, allocations or active polling in the normal phone direct path.

Only compare untreated R21 and candidate wake speed with the inherited AB/BA protocol when both have comparable untreated direct episodes: four independently started processes, one initial + three warm slots each, retain all 16 planned slots including failure/fallback. Same hardware/config/calibration, no holds or scripted phase forcing in a speed run. Keep prior gate of at least 50ms lower comparable median to native apply with same improvement direction in each order, no worse withdrawal/continuity or extra failures. R21 handset median 392ms and the R22.2 emulator 2836ms are different populations. Do not block structural diagnosis on an absent handset or report a timing pass without observations.

## 8. CURRENT SOURCE FACTS

A direct FULL wake can allocate before wake and bind a blank layer without a FULL picture. KeyguardCardWindow.prepareRetainedView/prepareR18 and KeyguardOrbR18Presenter.prepare pass no private profile for that blank allocation. The producer has a two-entry poster map keyed by visual identity, full flag, size, density and phase. KeyguardOrbR18Presenter.seal calls worker.revoke with discardFull=true, and the worker drops FULL posters for that path. A matching authorized hit saves first-paint work; a miss creates a painter and writes the exact target directly. No detached continuous animation. Exact cache-history per miss is unobserved. Fresh eligible system state, a complete current MAIN read and current data/material/route/attachment identities are still required. Screen-on or keyguard-locked alone cannot distinguish an occluding window, shade or credentials.

## 9. PROVEN / UNPROVEN / MISSING

PROVEN in L4/L6/F1: after successful A→B, a new pending request was admitted during B, B returned SHOW_FULL, the recorded first positive was stale and final grant came from 85/135/196. The first C offer left 63/30/67 ms until B's recorded completion. In L4 the latest observed C was itself the final proof; L6 and F1 ultimately used a later request than the last C recorded during B. This elapsed tail is an upper bound on the portion of those B reads potentially removable, before accounting for in-flight calls or rework. Even removing all three tails would average only 20 ms over these eight wakes, ignoring downstream changes. UNPROVEN: a safe pre-child checkpoint remained after C in each B, or starting C earlier would improve final display. MISSING: a matched comparison, reason-by-reason time for the other five and first physically visible frame. More cache hits, capture mode and an intrinsically slow graphics backend are unestablished explanations of the whole symptom.

## 10. ROOT-CAUSE / FORENSIC GATE

The source suppresses every further scheduling claim once A is consumed and only installs a handle for the original request. This explains why obsolete work can continue in B; it does not establish its optical cost. Select a bounded repair of this one consequence. Prove a parent RED with real reader after C and before another nonessential B child call. If the gated AVD/handset trial instead shows mostly in-flight calls, disqualifiers, or a chain that simply moves delay to another read, return that result; another recursive handoff or a wholesale renderer rewrite is not authorized.

## 11. SCOPE LOCK

Only the API35 R18 direct FULL, unpublished, virgin-output wake after a real A transfer. At most two successful transfers total for one wake. Discreet, fallback, non-35, motion off, attached/showing, Home widget, Flutter dashboard, financial painting, static images, touch, animator and unlock cleanup use the existing behavior. No debounce, event ignore list, optimistic display, previous-wake proof, cached authorization, parallel walkers, global prefetch or hidden FULL buffer across privacy boundaries.

## 12. LAYERS / BOUNDS / OWNERSHIP

Keep overlay bounds, window type, z-order, input and accessibility semantics identical. No layer or bitmap change. Main owns UI and final grant; the single reader owns and recycles framework objects. queueLock owns the active/pending scalar and identities. The volatile hint merely avoids locking at ordinary child visits. B's handle is bound to exact reservation, authority and read-start scene; B's expiry cannot cancel the later owner. All extra state is bounded to this wake; no event text, node objects, extra threads or indefinite storage.

# Fluvi R24 — Android-wide first-frame ORB architecture decision

FLUVI_R24_ANDROID_FIRST_FRAME_BEGIN

## 1. Title and disposition

This supersedes the R23 B-to-C reader change as the response to the owner's wake-latency requirement. The product is a normally installable Android app, across manufacturers, with no per-model policy. The requested limit is **10 ms maximum**. This is an architecture decision and a stop instruction for the superseded assignment. The design below identifies the missing platform contract. There is no approved APK implementation of the universal deadline. Preserve any independent work already produced. Do not start an R23 build on the strength of its older handoff.

## 2. Authoritative application state

At review time the remote branch-name check returned only the coordination ref for the R23/R24 search. A local or unpushed branch cannot be inferred from that result.

The project assets in the review workspace are project_sources/02-FLUVI_PROMPT_WRITER_RULES-1-.md, project_sources/01-FLUVI_WIDGET_DEBUGGING_PROMPT_ADDENDUM-1-.md and project_sources/03-DEBUGGING_LOOP_VERY_IMPORTANT.txt.
